insighttimer.title: Exceptional!!
insighttimer.content:
Insight Timer supports me unlike any other app or group. At my convenience and frequency, I’m able to go anywhere my body, brain or Life needs to support my wellbeing. The variety of topics and styles are incredibly helpful for the many challenges and situations I find myself in. These tracks help ground me and provide me peace and solace.
Thanks for providing these valuable teachers and content for all !! Thank you, thank you to all the wonderful teachers.

insighttimer.title: Yes ! 10 years of use, still the best.
insighttimer.content:
I just hit 1,100 hours logged on this app since I began meditating around 2016!

The app is perfect and I love that it tracks the amount.

insighttimer.title: Best app!
insighttimer.content: Insight Timer has it all. I use the timer quite a bit, and there are also so many guided meditations of many types with teachers that I love, and I can search by length depending on how much time I have. My kids love the sleep stories. Basically, I can always find what I am hoping for.

insighttimer.title: Peaceful beginnings
insighttimer.content: I have been using this app daily for the past 250 days or so and have benefited so much through its intention setting first thing in the morning, and then at least one guided meditation.  The sense of calm, peace, and serenity it has brought to my life is incalculable.

insighttimer.title: Pretty Great
insighttimer.content: I really enjoy this app, and get a lot of benefits from just what you can do for free. It has a lot of wonderful features that help with building consistency in your practice without making you feel guilty or judged.  Very user friendly, with many different options for all sorts of people. My only complaint, and I admit it’s selfish, is having the paid aspects. I realize everyone needs to make money, I just prefer the donation model within the free classes. I’d rate it as a 4.75 if that was an option.

insighttimer.title: Gratitude for this moment
insighttimer.content: Insight Timer gives you the tools you need to appreciate every moment. I am so grateful for all the teachers sharing their expertise on how to find peace and joy in this beautiful life.

insighttimer.title: Insight Timer is essential
insighttimer.content: Insight Timer is a life changing tool that has brought peace, harmony, and gratitude into my life. There are amazing teachers and practices on the app to meet what your need when you need it. It is essential in my life and I am so grateful for them it and the Insight community.

insighttimer.title: Five Years and Counting
insighttimer.content: Excellent, helpful app. Starting the day with meditation, music, a multi day course has been my routine for five years. Love this app.

insighttimer.title: Great app but too many prompts!
insighttimer.content:
While I really appreciate all the artists who have produced music and soundscapes for this app, I don’t like the manipulative feel of the app overall. One is constantly cajoled to tell how you’re feeling, to journal, to tell how committed you are, etc. 
I really wish there were a setting to turn off all this “coaching”.

insighttimer.title: Perfect
insighttimer.content: The best thing about my phone!

insighttimer.title: Neurosomatic Training and for such a low cost
insighttimer.content: I absolutely love the mixer I sleep with it every night and have been getting more rem and deep sleep!  And the challenges and different classes some of them are awesome!  I get a lot from this app!

insighttimer.title: Design flaw
insighttimer.content: There’s a lot of variety and a huge library to sift through. However - why would the developers give us the option to bookmark or save for later if there doesn’t appear to be a way to access those? Shouldn’t there be a navigation option at the bottom of the screen to take me to *my* page with content I’ve curated? I went to go find a guided meditation I enjoyed and bookmarked, and there’s no way to access them except to go through my history of activity. That’s poor design and I’d really like to see this fixed, given the price I’m paying for the subscription.

insighttimer.title: Fantastic App
insighttimer.content:
I have used Insight timer for years.  It has grown with me over the years as my practice has change and expanded.  The choices are numerable and I can set it exactly as I want and even have several choices for the situations I use it for.   
I love the choices for meditations!!

insighttimer.title: Every Day for 12 Years
insighttimer.content: Insight Timer keeps me sane, compassionate, grateful, loving. I use the app every single day. So much content. Something for everyone. Highly recommend.

insighttimer.title: Too much talking
insighttimer.content: Why does everyone talk so much? Everytime I start a meditation with someone, I just wish they shut up a little so I can settle into it without so much interpretation. I wish there was a filter for the ones that didn't have so much handholding through the whole thing.

insighttimer.title: Every Day
insighttimer.content: Insight Timer is a part of my life. and I so appreciate all of the tools, beautiful prayers and meditations, music, courses, talented and gifted practitioners who contribute to our souls growth daily. I would really be lost without it. It has become a cornerstone in my life. Thank you for the creation of this beautiful site and all the content within it.

insighttimer.title: My Favorite App
insighttimer.content:
There is no other app that offers such a wide variety of options for every need and every point of view. 

Insight Timer helps me sleep at night and energizes me in the morning. The wide variety of meditations, courses, talks, and music provides something for every taste and mood.

insighttimer.title: Thank you, Insight Timer!
insighttimer.content:
You have truly changed my life.
The very first thing I do every morning is open this app and meditate. It has become my sanctuary and the best way to begin each day with peace, gratitude, and hope.
As a cancer patient, I found a home in your meditations and lessons. During some of the most difficult moments of my life, they gave me comfort, strength, and a new perspective. They taught me how to be present, how to let go of fear, and how to find joy even in challenging times.
Because of Insight Timer, I can honestly say I am a better human being. I am more compassionate, more resilient, and more connected to myself and to others.
Thank you to every teacher and every person who has made this beautiful community possible. Your work has touched my heart in ways I can never fully express.
With endless gratitude. ❤️

insighttimer.title: Almost Perfect
insighttimer.content:
I love this app. I love all the free options and the ability to pay creators directly. I love the breadth of the app. 

I am holding out on paying for the premium version until they figure out how to let you sort and filter more intuitively. Until then, this is a hidden gem.

insighttimer.title: Family Sharing
insighttimer.content: Would be happy to give a full five star rating but cannot do so because it lacks family sharing. My spouse, has trouble staying asleep and as such has tried to use Insight Timer to fall/stay asleep but is limited to the number of titles she can use. she would like to use some of the 2 to 4 hour sleep sessions,i.e. music but but cannot access them as needed. Very disappointed.

insighttimer.title: Wonderful app
insighttimer.content: I use the meditations and yoga practices daily  and there is always something that meets what I need.

insighttimer.title: My daily
insighttimer.content: I have been using Insight Timer for years. For many years I just used the free app and there are literally hundreds of thousands of meditations that are wonderful. A few years ago I decided to go with the annual paid subscription, and I love it! Absolutely the best $60 I spend on myself!

insighttimer.title: Love it!
insighttimer.content: There are so many wonderful meditations in this app as well as nature background misuses. Very calming and so many options to choose from you are bound to find something you like.

insighttimer.title: Lots of room for improvement
insighttimer.content: I’ve been a paid subscriber for several years and this is my take. The app offers plenty of meditation options. It also has a lot of material that is more directed towards therapy instead of actual meditation. The way that everything is laid out can be confusing and difficult to navigate resulting in time wasted. When they change their format they don’t notify you so you have to figure out where everything went on your own and that can be frustrating especially if you’re an early morning meditator with time constraints. It has some really good features but equally has some very frustrating issues that they don’t seem to know how to address. Customer service is very “nice” but rarely helpful. Be prepared to fix whatever comes up yourself if you choose them.

insighttimer.title: Excellent!
insighttimer.content: The app is simple, but it really has done the trick for me. I’m now several years into a surprisingly consistent streak of meditating daily. And the benefits are undeniable.

insighttimer.title: Mostly good
insighttimer.content: I like the timer and settings quite a bit. The brass bowl tones are wonderful. I’ve done some guided meditations. Also that are good. However, I’m pretty turned off by the comments that I get when I don’t reach my goals/commitments. They feel a bit judgmental and I would preferred to either not receive them or see them reframed in more positive encouraging language.

insighttimer.title: Fave App
insighttimer.content: When I left my phone at work, I was most upset because I wouldn’t have access to the meditations, music, reiki, tapping & other modalities available on Insight Timer!  It has become such an important part of my daily life - and my soul has flourished with it!!!!   Thank you so much, Insight Timer.  Continue to light up our world!

insighttimer.title: Amazing App
insighttimer.content: I’ve been an Insight Timer user for years now. The premium plan is so affordable for what you have access to. Amazing meditations, binaural, music, reiki, etc. AND courses galore. There are live streams with teachers and I just can’t express how much Insight Timer makes my life better. Thank you!

insighttimer.title: Anger
insighttimer.content: Very helpful quite intense to stop the body aches

insighttimer.title: Best meditation app
insighttimer.content: Find exactly what you need in this versatile app.

insighttimer.title: Forcing video into my mindfulness practice? Absolutely not.
insighttimer.content:
As someone who works in media, I’m keenly aware of how insidious the “pivot to video” creep has become. My favorite meditation app was the last place I expected it to show up. 

I’ve been a dedicated Insight Timer user for over a decade. It’s where I go to unplug, ground myself and literally *close my eyes.* What’s kept me loyal to IT is how calming and low-stimulation the user experience is — it used to be so simple and practical, like the Reddit of meditation apps. I loved that it never really changed. So waking up one morning to find a carousel of *meditation videos* (who is asking for these, seriously?) suddenly featured at the top of the home screen, with no way to turn the feature off, feels manipulative and totally inconsistent with the app’s original purpose. Seeing so many faces staring back at me (with sleek, professional lighting and backgrounds) when I’ve opened the app specifically to get away from that vibe grosses me out, like self-improvement is being TikTokified.

Miss me with this redesign. If there truly is a demand for video content in this space (which I find hard to fathom), there are ways to meet it without forcing the rest of us to go down the scroll hole with you. I’m taking my meditation practice elsewhere, and I hope everyone serious about their practice does too.

insighttimer.title: So so helpful
insighttimer.content: My therapist recommended this app years ago and I’ve been a huge fan ever since. I always recommend it to friends whether it’s meditations or content for kids. I love that my kids ask to listen to meditations or stories (for bedtime) and sometimes when I’m just done and maxed out it’s an amazing tool in my box! I can’t recommend this app enough - both the Plus version and regular. And I appreciate there’s lost of content on the free version and no pressure to upgrade.

insighttimer.title: a million steps to click through
insighttimer.content: every time you reopen the app it takes you through a 2 minute onboarding. used to be way better and now it’s annoying

insighttimer.title: They Practice What They Preach
insighttimer.content: I’m so grateful that there is so much available to all that I pay for advance services. Hope more and more can be shared for free to those who need that service.

insighttimer.title: Thank you.
insighttimer.content: Peace was my intention because this session made me feel peaceful so thank you.

insighttimer.title: Insight Timer has renewed my Faith in a Loving higher Power.
insighttimer.content: Insight Timer is allowing me to become the me that I want to be. It allows me to evolve into my best self. I’ve only used the free version. I would love to upgrade but can’t afford it right now. Still the free version is amazing. I am constantly recommending it to my family. I’ve gone through a crisis of faith in the past 10 years. Timer has given me an abundance of paths to find a new faith. I have found new meanings and new wisdoms in which I can trust and believe. I am grateful for Insight Timer. Thank you.

insighttimer.title: The best meditation app
insighttimer.content:
I have had the opportunity to try out  many meditation apps. This is easily the best. Thank you to the developers.

Update: still the best!

insighttimer.title: Best app for diversity of ideas
insighttimer.content: I love that I can find endless wisdom from the sea of experience fr all the other users.

insighttimer.title: Very good and beatifully curated app
insighttimer.content:
I’ve used Insight Timer for more than five years, and it’s one of the few apps I’ve consistently kept. It has made a real difference in my life. The quality of the content is excellent, it’s thoughtfully curated, and there’s always something valuable to discover. The membership is absolutely worth the cost. I recommend it to anyone interested in meditation, sleep, or personal growth.
Thank you! 🙏❤️

insighttimer.title: Helpful
insighttimer.content: The app has been helpful and easy to use with access to educational information.

insighttimer.title: My favorite app by far
insighttimer.content: This app has helped change my life. I opened this app a couple of years ago and didn’t know anything about meditation and now I meditate daily!

insighttimer.title: Zaps battery
insighttimer.content: Really dig the app, but it really depletes the cell phone battery quickly.

insighttimer.title: absolutely amazing
insighttimer.content:
i use this app every day and it’s given me the motivation to meditate daily which has been extremely beneficial for my mental health. 
still a pretty perfect app even with just the free version. 
the only thing i wish is that i could scroll forward on the audios without the membership subscription. sometimes i just want to see if its an actual meditation or just a poem or advice. but thats the only thing i would change.

insighttimer.title: Feeling manipulated
insighttimer.content: Content of the app is great. The barrage of questions and goal-setting that the app requires to get to the content feels paternalistic and manipulative. I know what I’m looking for on the app and I don’t want to be required to go through 9 steps of setting goals and answering questions before I get to the content I want. Also, I already answered these stupid questions 2 months ago (only stupid because I don’t want them and they’re being forced on me—-fine if I want to set goals), and now I olen the app and can’t access anything until I go through the whole rigamarole again. AT LEAST put an option to skip. Or ASK if people want help from the app setting up goals and make it a choice.

insighttimer.title: App has become burdensome
insighttimer.content: This app has good teachers that meet any preferred meditation or mindfulness style, but the app creators have loaded the app with burdensome questions about preferences and commitments and goals that are anxiety inducing. There is no way to opt out or ex out of these questions (i have all optional settings set accordingly) and they are obviously trying to get you to subscribe at every turn. This is my OG meditation app, and I hate using it now.

insighttimer.title: A GIFT!
insighttimer.content: I get what I need! It doesn’t matter if I a have a few minutes or more time. I can always come back to calm and acceptance.

insighttimer.title: Best App Purchase Ever
insighttimer.content: I start my day with Insight Timer.  I am on day 604 of consecutive meditation.  This app ushered me into a transformative practice that has literally changed how I feel and show up in the world.  The courses are relevant, helpful and accepting.  The instructors are kindhearted and wise.  I am worth the investment of time and resources.  So are YOU, Beloved.♥️🙏🏾♥️

insighttimer.title: Great app
insighttimer.content: So many wonderful instructors and meditations are available! I have find something for every focus I have wanted.  🙏

insighttimer.title: Used to be one of my favorites
insighttimer.content: This app used to be one of my favorites but this latest update makes it so difficult to start a timed meditation or playlist that it is not worth using. I do not want to answer 15 questions about my goals when I only have 3 minutes for a quick refresh.

insighttimer.title: Used to be great
insighttimer.content: Redesign is terrible. You cannot turn off or have a choice on things you don't want to see. Certain categories of meditations are dominated by a few individuals. Playlists and downloads are now impossible to find (probably removed). Such a shame as IT was an amazing app but not anymore.

insighttimer.title: Bloated pile of garbage now
insighttimer.content: I got this app back when it first launched. When it was just a simple timer with a few cool bell sounds for $2.99. Fast forward to now—it has met the same fate as most apps do where they start out with a cool concept and genuine value to consumers but just keep growing getting bigger until they bloat and choke themselves out. Now there’s pop ups everywhere, subscriptions ($70 for a bell sound?! Come on you people have lost your minds) and just complete chaos where to get to the simple bell sound you have to navigate a complex maze of windows, offers, and subscription reminders. Any serious mindfulness affectionado would do themselves well to avoid such apps and tech entirely and  look for nature and timeless real world mindfulness anchors as people have been doing for hundredths of years.

insighttimer.title: Exceptional
insighttimer.content: There’s a reason this is the world’s most popular meditation app

insighttimer.title: Fullness
insighttimer.content: I love this app I start my day with is as much as possible

insighttimer.title: Wonderful
insighttimer.content: I am so incredibly grateful for this app. All the meditations, guidance, love and support. Download and start anywhere. You are worthy! Feel good now!

insighttimer.title: Incredible app!
insighttimer.content: I’m blown away by how much quality content is available for free, and how customizable the settings are. Best meditation/mindfulness app I’ve tried and I’m always recommending it to others.

insighttimer.title: Best meditation app for the people bar none
insighttimer.content: I’ve been using insight timer for years. It’s my go to app for tracking my yoga and meditation practices. And for discovering new teachers and new content from old teachers. I love the layout of the platform and the community building aspect. I also love all that you get for a nominal price every year- it’s unbeatable. Thank you Insight Timer team!

insighttimer.title: I use this app EVERY DAY!
insighttimer.content: I have used this app every day for several years.  It’s truly amazing and has helped me so much.  Definitely glad I upgraded to the premium membership.  Not everything on here is for me but there are some awesome teachers, tracks and courses that have helped me so much!

insighttimer.title: Set up questions too often!
insighttimer.content: This app used to be my favorite. Now it’s not. Every time I open the app it asks me a series of “set up” questions before offering the paid subscription. The set up questions don’t seem to serve any purpose but to affect the particular wording used on the subscription offer page. Having to answering questions each time before I access content is frustrating and prevents me from actually using and enjoying the app. Which by the way is what would cause me to choose to subscribe- an enjoyable, easy user experience. I do not recommend this app anymore unless you come here intending to subscribe right away.

insighttimer.title: So many choices for peace be
insighttimer.content: I love this app. Calling it an app does not reflect the help, guidance and peace that it offers.

insighttimer.title: Liars
insighttimer.content: Was told I would be reminded when my 7 day trial was over and I was not. I didn’t like the app and was charged $60 anyways when I deleted it. Do not trust this developer, they want to take money from poor single moms

insighttimer.title: Life changing
insighttimer.content: A wealth of knowledge and peace and encouragement in a very busy world. Thank you.

insighttimer.title: Playlists broken
insighttimer.content:
Playlists have been broken for me for weeks. I can no longer listen to my curated sleep playlists. Every time it stops after the first track. Support tried to help, but nothing has been resolved. I’ve uninstalled, created new playlists, etc. but nothing works. I now have to be content with one track unless I want to open the app each time and select the next. 

The constant UI changes are also frustrating. Having to constantly figure out where I am and where my favorites are is annoying. Also the amount of steps you have to go through after a track takes me out of any calm mindset I achieve. Asking for ratings, the slow running day count screen, this and that. Not everything needs to be so convoluted. I guess I need to go find a meditation for anger now.

insighttimer.title: A lifeline
insighttimer.content: Not sure I can move through all life’s up and downs without this app

insighttimer.title: Down hill
insighttimer.content: I used to really like this app with a paid member for several years and at that time it was a great app. But in the last few years, it’s gotten more and more like a game and more and more like I’m there to answer their marketing questions. I opened the app today to meditate and there was a series of questions that I had to answer before I could even do it. That’s not why I’m there. You shouldn’t have to put up with all that if you’re paying for an app that is supposed to bring you peace of mind.

insighttimer.title: Gamification detracts from contemplation
insighttimer.content: So when this app was commercialized, it did become really annoying. There are frequent requests for funds. I continue to use it because the one feature I use, the timer, can be engineered so that it opens immediately when you open the app. But at the end of each session, there is an obtrusive streak invitation that you have to either accept or swipe the app closed. And you actually have to get a paid membership to turn the streak pressure off. My meditation practice mostly takes place in the real world with my religious group, so repeated virtual streak invitations are a waste of time. And every time I finish a timer session, I lose a little bit of the peace of mind I gained to this app’s mindless attempts to gamify my mindfulness.

insighttimer.title: I Love Insight Timer
insighttimer.content: I love Insight Timer. No other meditation app that I’ve tried offers the variety of amazing meditations that always starts my day right or ends it on a high note. Thank you.

insighttimer.title: As of 2026
insighttimer.content: I generally love this app and its resources. However, like many other platforms, this one is constantly changing the layout & settings which is extremely annoying. Can’t a girl just get her meditation on and not have to deal with all of these questions & prompts when she logs in? Stop making things more complicated insight!!!

insighttimer.title: Was better before they over- thought it
insighttimer.content: This used to be a great app. They have added useless and time-consuming clicks, very mediocre daily quotes that I have to click through, continuous bait to subscribe to their “challenges“, that I find myself getting annoyed before and after every meditation that’s supposed to calm me down.  Many of their quotes are ridiculous and some are offensive - it would be better if they left them out rather than pretend to be profound, and in the process be irritating to  different belief systems.    And why after each meditation do I have to click five times in order to get out of the app and save my data. And no, I don’t care about my streak, that should be an opt out button.  I love the gongs and the bells and the timer. I don’t love no longer being able to find the meditations that I’ve enjoyed in the past, but being pushed into newer teachers, that I don’t particularly want to listen to.  I’m hoping a competitor will come along, so I will have another option for daily meditation timers.  Sorry to be negative when their mission is good but the developers need to rethink.

insighttimer.title: WONDERFUL
insighttimer.content: I’ve been using this app for more than 10 years. Is a gift to us all. Thank you

insighttimer.title: ✅ Member for over  12 years
insighttimer.content: An absolute must !

Namaste and gentle bows to all. I love this app and my number one app for me because I become centered slow my breathing, focused, work on my peaceful Yoga stance, strengthen my core, performed better. There is a variety of venues from joining a live session to music breathing •  nighttime •meditations and so much much more. 

My life is aligned with Insight App and even there are high frequency transient music, song bowls, and story telling. Namaste to all of my new friends at Insight Timer. We are connected through our love for self*hope*faith and so we go out into our daily lives with Love of self. When we love ourselves we love one another. Peace Joy to all of you and me too ❕🌈🧘🏽‍♀️🦄🪉🎧📚🎼🥰

insighttimer.title: 500+ Days my Daily Go To
insighttimer.content: This app works. Just use the timer, and meditate. You’ll see the difference over time. Be sure to set up the widget to track your progress.

insighttimer.title: Amazing app
insighttimer.content: This app has truly transformed my mornings. Every day I begin with meditation guided by an incredible variety of gifted teachers, and each session brings me more peace, clarity, and joy. I’m so grateful to be part of such a supportive and inspiring community. It has become a beautiful part of my daily life.

insighttimer.title: UI makes it impossible to find stuff
insighttimer.content: The constant UI changes are so frustrating! I love the meditations, but I cannot find anything I am looking for, which then makes what is supposed to promote relaxation stressful. I cannot find my bookmarks when they used to be easy to locate. Why so many changes that just bloat the app? It’s bad design.

insighttimer.title: Love it!!
insighttimer.content: This is my first time getting back into the app for a while. I have a widget set on my home screen that’s helpful as a reminder to pause. I was thrilled to find Dora on the app because I always chose her voice when I used the Headspace app. I love seeing teachers of color on the app as well. 🫶🏼

insighttimer.title: The best wellness tool
insighttimer.content: Ive been a user of insight timer since 2019, i dont use it as much as i want to now but its a must tool for me whenever i do need it. Theres nothing like it.

insighttimer.title: Took years to start really using this app
insighttimer.content:
I’ve had Insight Timer for years but just a few month’s ago, I upgraded to Pro and really began my journey.  Now it is a part of my daily practice.
It is such a wealth of resources for peace of mind.
Its a huge gift and if everyone in the planet could use it, the world would be a better place!

insighttimer.title: 10 years strong
insighttimer.content: This app is the only meditation app I have ever used. It’s amazing to see how much it has improved over last 10 years and the community it’s built. If I log onto the app, it’s a great day.

insighttimer.title: Great resources but one annoying thing
insighttimer.content: I love the meditations so much but please don’t make me go through the several screens at the end that force “committing” to the next x days. I am a long time paying customer and it’s a frustrating UX experience which ruins the vibe after a good mediation session. I don’t want to commit but I don’t want to discard the session either. Please add a skip button to that whole flow.

insighttimer.title: Much needed for mental health
insighttimer.content: I am so incredibly grateful for this app. I use it almost every day for meditation for learning something new and for getting grounded in my body and with mother earth thank you thank you.

insighttimer.title: What happened?
insighttimer.content: I’ve had this app since 2016, and never had this problem, but it’s been ongoing for months now snd hasn’t been fixed so now adjusting my review. Every time I open the app, it thinks it’s my first time logging in and had me go through the long I take questions every single time. Which has actually steered me away to not use this platform anymore. So developers, this is something to look into. Would love to come back!

insighttimer.title: Why?
insighttimer.content: I have used IT for several years and have a committed practice. The app has helped me connect with and learn from a variety of teachers, several of them truly stellar.

insighttimer.title: Love Insight Timer
insighttimer.content: I’m there are so many beneficial opportunities with Insight Timer; everyone should use it!

insighttimer.title: Stop the distracting engagement and data collection in the app
insighttimer.content: This is one of my favorite apps. I’ve spent many hours rejuvenating, relaxing, healing and seeking guidance. It’s easy to use and has fantastic content and teachers.  I don’t use the app anymore, because of the questions and engagement that are forced upon users.  In meditation, I’m looking for a clear mind, safety, and detachment from the business and chaos of the world.  When I’m forced to “committ” or set a pretense of “choose a reason why you’re here” or my meditation time and use is thrown in my face…. I am suddenly not safe.  I am being treated like a consumer. My mind is no longer free to use the content, as I am now tracked, prodded, and brainwashed with an emphasis on the app.  I can’t just meditate peacefully anymore.  I’m forced to face the reality of a consumer based world.  Ive become targeted.  The purity of meditation is ruined by the app.  My head cannot be clear.  I feel frustration that I have to exchange my simple calm meditation practices for my data and engagement on the app.  I am not talking about paid membership- that makes sense.  I’m not talking about teachers getting paid.  I just want the option to “skip” or turn off the questions and app guidance.  If I am forced to put my mind in consumer mode, I won’t use the app.

insighttimer.title: Thankful
insighttimer.content: What a great tool --the free version is filled with every you could imagine. So many teachers and topics . Very grateful to have this tool for my journey

insighttimer.title: Love it
insighttimer.content: Been using this app for years. It’s great! One thing I don’t like though is that they made it harder to get to my bookmarks.

insighttimer.title: Best healing partner
insighttimer.content: I have relied on Insight Timer for years to help me through life‘s challenges. There’s always a tool, a teacher , a meditation available to me anytime I need it. The quality of instructors that I follow is really impressive. I don’t know what I would do without this app.

insighttimer.title: Best Meditation App bar none.
insighttimer.content: If not for this app I wouldn’t have serenity in my life. Simple, easy, clean. Perfect. Thank you.

insighttimer.title: Excellent
insighttimer.content: I’ve used insight timer for 8 years and it’s helped me stay committed to my meditation practice, love it!

insighttimer.title: Life changing
insighttimer.content: My ‘go to’ site for peace and acceptance for 14 years.

insighttimer.title: Best app ever
insighttimer.content: I have been using insight timer for 6 years now. I use it for relaxation, meditation, affirmation and learning new things. Whatever I need structure and peace of mind it’s right there.

insighttimer.title: Amazing tool for meditating consistently
insighttimer.content: I’ve meditated for 600+ consecutive days because of this app helping me track my meditation. I am so grateful

insighttimer.title: I use this app daily
insighttimer.content:
I use this meditation timer at least once a day. I found the perfect chime to begin and end my sessions. It's so great to Tracy my sessions. I’m at 5k+
days. I recommend all the time to people new to or experienced with meditation.

insighttimer.title: My go to meditation app’
insighttimer.content: I have been using this app for years and recommend it to all of my friends, neighbors, fellow yogis, and meditationers! Simply the best app for monitoring your meditation sessions!

insighttimer.title: Was 5 stars
insighttimer.content: They got rid of the option to have your daily intention automatically repeat for a day, a week, a month. That’s gone now.

insighttimer.title: Thank you!
insighttimer.content: I have used Insight Timer for over 8 years now. I enjoy the playlist option, and have different playlists for different times of day or what I feel like. I used the Timer to meditate, and choose different bells and background sounds. I also appreciate the challenges that are provided throughout the year. So many options and opportunities to use this app, as well as connect with people all over the world!

insighttimer.title: Destroying values
insighttimer.content: This app is a great tool, I just wish they would start living by the values they are trying to help people worth. Their goal is to help people live a better life yet they push push notifications even when I said no. It has happened twice. They make you go thought a survey when you come back, I don’t believe it is to be helpful, I see it as just another way for them to get more info on me.

insighttimer.title: Love this
insighttimer.content: I have hundreds of total days and thousands of hours where I have meditated with Insight Timer.  That meditation has helped me immensely, is an understatement. I have found guidance and support. I love this App. So many different teachers, topics, and subjects to listen to.

insighttimer.title: the bell
insighttimer.content: the chime and the sound of meditation may be started by the spins of a bell. however it is always existent and started far before. my most favorite sound is a special intentional bell in the key of E or so they say. the tubes and the bells are vessels like my family and how we stay in touch. the wind blowing through the vessels also i feel from far away and i can hear them from every angle or vessel. my body my mind my dreams are open to this and will never forget: i held a seashell to my ear and i heard the ocean, only because my parents told me to pay attention. they were right: at the same night I has adopted an orphan calico kitten from the sea, so when i heard the ocean i realized where she had come from. the beauty of life is finding clues and learning to trust each other lea. into each other there is a language far deeper and it speaks in code of nature .

insighttimer.title: Life changing
insighttimer.content: I tell people about this app all the time. I mostly only use the timer but love the guided meditations, music and lessons. Thank you for staying free. Making it easily accessible for anyone to start. 😄

insighttimer.title: My anchor back to me
insighttimer.content: This app is life saving. I use it multiple times a day and first thing in the morning is essential. I wake up not happy. Anxious. In pain. It shifts me slowly so my mind and body can remember to release. To breathe, to feel the blessings and to absorb nature. It’s my daily anchor back to me.

insighttimer.title: The best
insighttimer.content: Insight Timer is the best meditation app available. Enjoy 100’s of free options and enjoy.

insighttimer.title: Excellent app
insighttimer.content: Excellent app that I have been using since almost 8 years now, makes me feel grounded and at peace and I can handle difficult days in a calmer way.

insighttimer.title: Amazing
insighttimer.content: This app is amazing! I have been using for the last 2 years and I try to use daily

insighttimer.title: Love it all
insighttimer.content: I appreciate this platform deeply. I love the tracker bc it pushes me to stay consistent. I love the variety in tools and resources that we can utilize and integrate into our daily operations. Need this and absolutely find it critical to leverage at this time on my life.

insighttimer.title: Keeps getting worse
insighttimer.content:
More prompts to upgrade, and poor premium content.  The premium sounds are poor quality so I started to use brain.fm. Then the timer would be unreliable when I used 3rd party audio. Now they’ve added so many prompts to upgrade I’ve decide to uninstall and find something else entirely. 

I have 900 hours of meditation history on this app and it’s so bad now I’d rather lose it than keep being treated like a cash machine.

insighttimer.title: Great app
insighttimer.content: I’ve had this app for years and use it daily. It’s very well organized according to your goal, whether it’s music, talks, courses or meditations. There’s a great variety of teachers, something for everyone! You can set up reminders if that’s helpful. If you have an issue and contact them they get back to you in a timely and pleasant manner.

insighttimer.title: Mental Freedom
insighttimer.content: I Love this app because It teaches me to be disciplined in my mind. It gives me mental freedom to explore positive thoughts and visions while learning how to meditate at different levels and stages in life.

insighttimer.title: Insight Timer
insighttimer.content: Insight Timer is a fantastic app for meditation. The content is outstanding and the creators are constantly improving the interface with the user. I highly recommend giving it a try.

insighttimer.title: Used to be far better
insighttimer.content: Originally downloaded this app about ten years ago and it was wonderful back then. I found about four meditations for anti-anxiety and sleep that I have gone back to repeatedly. However, two days ago I went back to this app after an unintended hiatus, and it pressured me to make an account, tried to coax me into paying for it, and WHAT REALLY DISAPPOINTS me is that I haven’t been able to find my top-favorite mountain themed sleep meditation. I wish I could at least remember the name of its male narrator. Anyway I tried sampling the mountain ones in a search this evening and none of them sound even remotely like the one I’m now missing. Unless I can find that one back, I might delete this app :(

insighttimer.title: Simply the best!
insighttimer.content: Best meditation app ever!

insighttimer.title: Uplifting and healing
insighttimer.content: IT has been part of my journey back to the Origin,  the universal energy of all and nothing. It has healed me, supported me, inspired me.  I recommend wandering through it finding the tracks and courses that work for you.  Try for what your life lets in, not perfection, let in what you need.

insighttimer.title: The Real Deal
insighttimer.content: This is an incredible resource for both beginner and life long contemplatives.   No manipulation no games no unnecessary self promotion .  It has made a huge difference in my life. The quality of the instruction, and the Meditation is truly remarkable and I feel quite blessed to be a part of Insight Timer.

insighttimer.title: Groove challenge
insighttimer.content: Always a challenge, always worth the effort. Great music that makes me feel like my breath is dancing, encouraging guidance, often with a good explanation of the benefits of the breathing technique.

insighttimer.title: My morning go-to moment
insighttimer.content: I use Insight Timer every day without fail even if it’s just to check in for a moment my average time spent is 20 to 30 minutes and it makes an enormous difference. Thank you for the wonderful, diverse and creative content on this platform.

insighttimer.title: Best meditation app, but…
insighttimer.content:
This is absolutely my favorite meditation app, but I cancelled my subscription today. 
While I love the vast number of guided meditations this app offers, I primarily just use its ‘timer’ feature. This is a part of the app that is already full enough in the free version that I didn’t NEED my subscription.

So, why did I cancel? Because I like to gamify my life. I had a streak of over 300 days of meditation achieved in the app’s “Milestones”. You can miss up to three days of using the app per month and still tell the app that you did meditate, thus keeping your milestones. 

I meditate every day. My meditations don’t need an app, nor do most of them do I do with the app open. But the app assumes that if I tell it I meditated more than 3 times in the month without the app being open that I’m lying.
I lost my milestone streak.
This kinda deflated my motivation of keeping this app as a subscription, as this gamification was the main reason I justified opening it before many of my meditations.

insighttimer.title: Lie Changing
insighttimer.content:
The end. 
Thank you, 
thank you, 
thank you.

insighttimer.title: 6.5 years
insighttimer.content: I have been using this app since I started meditating, about six and a half years ago.  I find the consistency of physically opening the app in the morning, having my timing bells, chimes, background music, and duration already programmed a welcoming way to return to meditation each day.  I do mediate without the app as well, but find the familiarity of returning to it like a coming home.  For me, meditation is about building that place within, outside the activity of the mind, and really expanding my awareness.  I am very grateful to Insight Timer for having the familiarity of a little pebble stone train to return back there each time.

insighttimer.title: Highly recommended for anyone wanting guidance to make mediation easier
insighttimer.content: This app makes it easy to learn how to meditate. If you, like me, struggled to sit still and stay focused, you may find terrific guidance, encouragement, and a method that fits your needs here. The variety of possibilities are numerous and I tried several types of meditation until I discovered what works for me. The sleep stories, music, calming sounds, and mantras have also been useful from time to time. I often recommend this to people and thought it was time to do a review. It may open up a whole new world for you.

insighttimer.title: Peaceful Abiding on digital timer
insighttimer.content: Insight timer has been an immense resource on my spiritual growth. From finding Michelle Zarrin, who helped me get comfortable meditating/slowing down in my busy mind, to finding Shambhala Meditation Center where I learned a solid meditation practice, Shamatha. Insight Timer has been with me for my 15k plus hours meditation journey on a 10 year path of peacful abiding.  Thank you for keeping this app Ad free and helping support the healing community with proper technology for mindfulness practice. Much love from yours truly, Mr G.

insighttimer.title: Pretty good but with design flaws
insighttimer.content: I’ve used Insight Timer maybe 700 times so I’m definitely a “user.” It works fine but there is one big design flaw that is truly irritating. When you finish meditating, the “continue” (“finished” that is) button is right on top of a discard session button. Probably at least twice I week I finish meditating but discard the session if I’m not super careful to not brush the discard option. Why, oh why, are these two completely opposite and not recallable options stacked on top of one another! Plus, over the years, it seems like the app has become bloated with features. Some of us just want a meditation timer. The other features are great — but I wish there were just a minimalist timer setting so I don’t have to always skip past multiple things I’m not interested in. Just saying.

insighttimer.title: The best
insighttimer.content: Used for years now at no cost. Thank you!!!

insighttimer.title: Meditation
insighttimer.content: I have wanted to improve my spiritual life but had found it difficult to find a path. Insight Timer has given me a path about which I am optimistic. I feel an increasing commitment to staying the course.

insighttimer.title: Transformational
insighttimer.content: I use this daily throughout work and leisure. It is indeed transformative.

insighttimer.title: The best one!
insighttimer.content: I started meditating during Covid to manage my anxiety. Since then I have been a daily user of this amazing app to help me manage stress and anxiety. There is always some meditation that resonates with me.

insighttimer.title: Meditation timer does not work
insighttimer.content: I really want to like this app and have been using it for months, but at this point, I have to stop because the core functionality, the meditation timer, simply does not work. it has a tendency to turn stop timing when the screen turns off. Which means that it's just unreliable. That's a pity, and I hope the team finds a way to sort this out, as it's been happening sporadically for the last 12 months.

insighttimer.title: My Favorite Meditation app for many years!
insighttimer.content: I have used this app for years and originally I mainly used the timer. After a surgery, I began using the guided meditations when I did my therapy sessions, which were painful. A couple of years ago, I decided to make meditation a daily commitment, and I upgraded to the yearly plan. I have learned so much about meditation and myself through the many guided meditations, sound meditations, and meditation instruction. There is no other meditation app I would use now.

insighttimer.title: My favorite app
insighttimer.content: If I could only have 1 app on my phone for the rest of my life, it would easily be Insight Timer.

insighttimer.title: I have used it every day for 10 years.
insighttimer.content: I use a guided or timed meditation every day for the last 10 years.  Calming my mind and improving my focus.   I highly recommend Insight Timer.

insighttimer.title: So many options
insighttimer.content: I enjoy how easy it is to find what you need. Sometimes you don’t even know you actually need and the app is great for that.

insighttimer.title: Really valuable
insighttimer.content: This is really valuable and useful every day. Thank you!

insighttimer.title: Commitment
insighttimer.content: I love this app. I use the timer for meditation and a concentration exercise. I prefer a bell or bowl sound over my phone songs. Also, if I need to fall back asleep I use some wonderful guided meditations or music. I have also used various guided meditations and listened to talks. It is very abundant with tools and access to teachers. I love it.

insighttimer.title: Sanctuary
insighttimer.content: I discovered this app over a decade ago and instantly recognized its power. It has many free offerings that has significantly improved the quality of my life and the lives of my loved ones, friends and clients. It became a natural part of my daily ritual. I was so inspired I became a teacher on the app and I absolutely love it!!! Best App Ever!!!

insighttimer.title: All
insighttimer.content:
I have used insight for almost 10 years.  Unfortunately I lost my
Old account, however that didn’t stop me from creating new and continuing.  I love Sarah Blondin!  Her voice is so soothing and her words touch my soul. She has gotten me through some of my most dark times.

insighttimer.title: Meditation as an Atomic Habit.
insighttimer.content: I only meditate 3 minutes a day. I mainly get it done first thing in the morning, but when I don’t, Insight Timer is there to remind me, as a widget on my home screen. Do I want to do more than 3 minutes? Of course, but right now this is the amount of time I can commit to. It’s an Atomic Habit! 😉

insighttimer.title: Love the app, hate the update
insighttimer.content: This is a fantastic app in so many respects, and I use it for live yoga, timing self guided meditation, and guided meditation as well.  I’ve got a extensive library of guided meditations I’ve curated over the years, and with the latest update they are very difficult to access.  This creates a lot of unnecessary frustration.  This was a 5 star app before they messed around with it.  I hope that soon a new update will create a better fix than letting me pin one playlist to my home page.

insighttimer.title: Amazing & Robust
insighttimer.content:
This app is truly amazing. The depth of experience and wisdom of the teachers, the intention setting, the widget option, the checklist and the filtering are all excellent tools that have helped me go much deeper in my practice. 

From someone who couldn’t sit still for even two minutes, to completing 20 mins of meditation on most day- has been life changing for me.

insighttimer.title: Insight Timer
insighttimer.content: I love this app! So many kinds of meditations and talks.

insighttimer.title: Setting an intention in the morning helps me to clarify my aim. Guided meditations help me settle.
insighttimer.content: Clarity and calm

insighttimer.title: Can we please our 2026 resolutions as a widget?
insighttimer.content: I would like to be able to have my 2026 resolution as a widget I can put on my Home Screen. Can you please make this happen?

insighttimer.title: So disappointing
insighttimer.content: Insight Timer has changed for the worse. I regret that I didn’t cancel in time to avoid paying for it for a year. Some of the content is great. The app is very much not great.

insighttimer.title: Used to be good
insighttimer.content: This used to be the best app for meditation but they added a bunch of nonsense features that make it hard to use the actual bell which is the only feature I want. The bell still works alright once you mess with the settings so it’s not asking you to write a journal or share your practice with other people.

insighttimer.title: This app changed my life!
insighttimer.content: This app is absolutely incredible and has changed how much, how often and how deeply I meditate. The guided meditations are incredible, add free and you can save your favorites. I love this app!

insighttimer.title: Wonderful resource!
insighttimer.content: Insight Timer is truly a gift if you’re experiencing personal unease, anxiety, and challenges. So many areas in which they provide insight, calm, and support.

insighttimer.title: Great Supplement and Beginning
insighttimer.content:
I have used Insight Timer for the past 6 years. While my usage hasn’t been consistent, it has been with me since the beginning of my meditation journey. There is a lot of content to discover if you enjoy guided meditation or lectures. Anyone can be a guide, so you have to pick and choose who you like to listen to.

Now I enjoy the timer and do my own breath work unguided. It is the perfect way to keep track of time. It also is a great motivator to keep a streak going. All around a great companion for any level of meditation.

insighttimer.title: My everything
insighttimer.content: This app has been my restorative partner for years now. It compliments life, career, therapy, and so much more! Whatever the need, it’s here when I need it. The diversity of options are just priceless.

insighttimer.title: Hermosa oración
insighttimer.content: Agradezco esta linda voz y su cariño con lo que usted grabó este meditación. Bendiciones para ti gracias

insighttimer.title: Asks 1000 question before starting
insighttimer.content: Uninstalled without using, since it is asking to subscribe before  even giving some idea what is the app about.

insighttimer.title: A true gift
insighttimer.content: This app is easily the best I've ever owned. Full of a plethora of healing resources, useful modes and operations. Much is free but I bought the year as a thank you to the developers and the practioners on there. Extremely grateful. Please don't change or sell out.

insighttimer.title: 😢Future course bookmark list gone
insighttimer.content: I have calmly tried to go through the revamped app and found my profile with playlist. Don’t give a flying flip about my statistics. Had book marked future courses has disappeared. Can’t the app creators give us a warning when you’re about to do an update and disappear our stuff. Guess I’ll scroll through and search all the 7k courses to figure out what I vibe with.

insighttimer.title: Why make the animations longer?
insighttimer.content:
I’ve finished meditating, why extend the time it takes to convey all that ending info? Just because I’m in a relaxed state doesn’t mean I want to spend more time in the app

Also, stop asking me to add a widget

A meditation app adding annoyances is kinda hilarious

insighttimer.title: It has become too similar to social media apps
insighttimer.content: I’ve used this app for over 8 years, but in the last couple years, it’s become a spiral of endless prompts and requests to continue and do I want to commit to a streak. I have toggled off all the prompts that I can, yet I still need to press continue or skip several times just to wrap up a meditation and find the next one. I often listen to a guided meditation more than once or go from one to the next. What used to be a simple app focused on mindfulness (rather than profit) has become an app that utilizes persuasive design, a manipulative technique often used by prominent social media companies to create addiction-like behavior in users. I miss the focus on mindfulness, rather than dopamine. I am currently trying other apps. Update: Ooo Thich Nhat Hanh’s Plum Village app is sweet and focused on mindfulness, free, and surprisingly full of resources.

insighttimer.title: Can’t skip annoying pop ups
insighttimer.content:
I usually use this app when I can’t sleep, or when I am looking for a specific meditation. 

This app constantly wants me to set a goal, or set an intention. I understand that might be useful for some, but it’s not what I need. 

It’s very annoying to have to skip past three different screens that feel like they’re scolding me just to get to the sleep meditation I want. 

I paid for this app, but I will not be renewing my subscription when it runs out.

insighttimer.title: The Best Meditation App Out There
insighttimer.content: I’ve been a member since 2017. I’ve tried a lot of meditation apps… this one is the best! The timer is simple and customizable. There is a huge library of FREE meditations. The paid Plus program also is top tier. Just try it and see for yourself!

insighttimer.title: Ease and Grace
insighttimer.content: Such an amazing appreciation; I always seem to get what I need.  These teachers speak from their heart and soul!✨✨✨✨💫

insighttimer.title: They make you sign up
insighttimer.content:
Cannot use the app without first personalizing the experience. User interface does not allow for continuing to use the app without answering "Tell me why you're here."  

Frustrating because I just want to use the app without having to give out this data to access the valuable content.

I want to be able to navigate the content without an AI personal assistant.

insighttimer.title: The variety is phenomenal
insighttimer.content: There’s a teacher/style for everyone and so appreciated. The courses offered give us so many choices. You’ll find the content that speaks to you the most. Highly recommend!

insighttimer.title: Keeps me centered
insighttimer.content: Today I hit 1921 straight days of some type of self care. Insight timer has been the focal point for my self care. It has rich content and allows the flexibility for you to acknowledge self care in many ways. I am so grateful for this application.

insighttimer.title: What happened?
insighttimer.content: As an off again, on again paid member, this app used to be great. There’s still great content, BUT I don’t want to constantly set goals, click thru pop ups, and I’m sick of getting the same 6 notifications at noon each day telling me to resume content I was interested in/completed in 2018 (despite having everything in encouragement and notifications turned off). Just stop!

insighttimer.title: Unexpectedly love this app
insighttimer.content: So good!  Lots of variety and has a new music mixer where you can combine sounds and music.  Very cool.

insighttimer.title: Good app👍
insighttimer.content: I use it to fall asleep every night and it helps so much

insighttimer.title: Best Meditation App
insighttimer.content: Best meditation app. I’ve tried Headspace and Calm but I like this better. Tons of content even in the free version. Great teachers. Search function helps you find any topic you’re interested in. I enjoy the practice of setting a daily intention.

insighttimer.title: done meditating? They want you to put money in the tip jar! after you pay for the app!
insighttimer.content: This was great when I first started using it, and I signed up for a year. At some point, they decided it was a good idea to ask for tips at the end of each experience. Like, “hey, our users are probably mellow right now. Let’s ask them for some money!”. It’s a total bummer and seems antithetical to the experience that people are trying to have. If I wanted to be pestered for money, I would sign up for our sicko president’s email list. WTAF? Did Elon Musk take over the app?

insighttimer.title: Love this app!
insighttimer.content: What is free is still so much than any other meditation app. I can find almost anything. Love it and use it every day. I talk about it all the time, too. Friends joke I’m the unofficial spokesperson.

insighttimer.title: Like it
insighttimer.content: At first, I just wanted to try it out. Well, I’ve found myself using it almost every day. There is so much available, even with the free version. Thank you.

insighttimer.title: Very helpful.
insighttimer.content: I love rouse the time with the various sing bowls.

insighttimer.title: Just because you can doesn’t mean you should
insighttimer.content: I have used this app for years and overall, I love it. A great variety of meditations and classes, something for everyone and every mood. Recently, however, they keep adding and adding. It’s starting to feel like a game and how many questions do I have to answer after I finish a meditation?! And no, I don’t want to tell you how I feel or if I’m committed to coming back tomorrow. This is a silly complaint for such a great app, but I find myself getting annoyed. Maybe I should meditate on it.

insighttimer.title: So soothing
insighttimer.content: This app helps me fall asleep so well!

insighttimer.title: Life Changing
insighttimer.content: After 84 days of 10-20 minute morning meditations, my life is changing and in consistent and joyful ways.

insighttimer.title: Just make some time for your self
insighttimer.content: 2 minute -20 minutes worth a moment of stillness to regroup your humanism

insighttimer.title: Largest AND Best Guided Library
insighttimer.content: As a mental health professional as well as just another human living my life, I have not met another app that has been this helpful, as filled with such a variety of valuable resources. Thank you insight timer staff for contributing to making this world a better place.

insighttimer.title: Cluttered. Pop ups. Busy
insighttimer.content: Really disappointed in the direction this app has taken. I’ve been using this app for years and it used to be a simple, peaceful experience. Now at the end of a meditation it forces you to navigate multiple pop up pages, pushes you to follow a meditation regimen, and makes you “commit” to return tomorrow. The home page is now full of videos which seem super unnecessary to me, and you have to filter those out to get a simple guided meditation. It feels like a social media company bought this app and is trying to addict our brains to it :(

insighttimer.title: Stressful
insighttimer.content: I created an account, paid. App didn’t work with my operating system. Got a new phone, can’t login, can’t start over, no response from customer service.

insighttimer.title: Update crashes
insighttimer.content: This is my favorite app, I use it daily, multiple times. However ever since the app updated last week, about 80% of the time that I try to open it, it stays frozen on the “insight timer” loading screen. I’ve deleted and reinstalled several times to no avail. IDK what else to do. I have an iPhone 11 with ample storage on my device and in iCloud.

insighttimer.title: Serenity
insighttimer.content: I now have so many choices to teach me better self care. This app is a way to lead me into my morning and evening meditations. They launch me gently into myself and my journey.

insighttimer.title: Great app!
insighttimer.content: I initially used it only for the timer and the cool sounds that you can get, but as I grew in my meditation practice I explored the guided meditation and challenges. I can say without a doubt that Insight Timer app has helped improve my mental health.

insighttimer.title: Sad decline
insighttimer.content: You keep adding features that don’t matter and putting more basic things behind the pay wall and the price has become ridiculous. I used to love and recommend insight timer but no more. It’s a sad decline of a  once great product.

insighttimer.title: Amazing!
insighttimer.content:
This app is truly amazing and has helped me tremendously. I have a request though. I have a widget set on my homepage and it would be fantastic to see the intention on the widget. 
Thank you.

insighttimer.title: Stop resetting my app
insighttimer.content: It’s great, the one thing is I don’t use the app every day, and if I’m inactive for a small period of time it resets my settings and makes me select why I’m back and it’s possibly the most infuriating thing when I just want to come back and do a short meditation

insighttimer.title: Fluff
insighttimer.content: Every update adds annoyances, more clicks for real meditators to deal with.

insighttimer.title: Recovery Resource
insighttimer.content: I’ve been using this app since I got sober, and it’s truly changed how much I meditate and how I feel rewarded for meditating more often

insighttimer.title: Thank you!
insighttimer.content: Amazing app. A lot of options, I love that it is so easy to use and to get start. The only app that has made the meditation habit stick in my routine

insighttimer.title: For the curious
insighttimer.content: The insight timer app is a wonderful tool to explore all different kinds of teachers. It is free to check out specific people and ideas. There are different formats to find what works for you. You can subscribe or just pay a particular teacher after the session. Love the flexibility of that.

insighttimer.title: Stellar content but counter productive app updates
insighttimer.content:
This is a very helpful app and resource for those seeking peace of mind.  The content and contributors are stellar 

But, with app updates, they rearrange the User Interface.  This can make it frustrating to find resources that were in use before the update. They will lose me as a customer

insighttimer.title: Love the content but not the recent update
insighttimer.content: The new update takes me to a landing page that I'm not interested in. I appreciate the intention-setting feature for the day, but when I try to use it, it prompts me to add a widget, which I find a bit annoying. I just want to add my intention directly. Additionally, I have to search more extensively for what I'm looking for, whereas it used to be conveniently accessible right on the home screen. Please make it easier to find content and teachers again. I cannot find my playlists either.

insighttimer.title: 5 stars

insighttimer.title: Life-changing—but changes too often
insighttimer.content:
UPDATE June 2026:
Another star removed. You have over-designed and over-gamified the once user-friendly app to the point that it’s unpleasant to use. I’m hoping I can avoid the new update touting “now more video!” as long as possible. One of the reasons  I have to meditate is to deal with cognitive overload and you’ve done nothing in the last year or so but overload this once amazing app. 

I love this app. It has changed my  life, enabling me to create a daily meditation practice, supported by wonderful teachers and guides. But the latest update is ill conceived and looks terrible. Why would a fussy font and more clicks to find resources be a good idea? Other major problems: ability to preview tracks is gone. The “how are you feeling” prompt within tracks is intrusive—give an option to turn that off (or if an option, make it findable). I am a premium user for many years and it’s mystifying to me that a meditation app would be redesigned to cause confusion and frustration.

insighttimer.title: Love it but…
insighttimer.content: I love this app but the new interface design is really unpleasant. Before, I was tracking all my recents/all time listened to history, to go through an sort an complete them all in full, but now it’s all bulky, showing every single session including the timer, an I can’t find them now. It’s all oversized, too zoomed in and confusing now. I don’t like it. I also don’t like how the expensive an overrated scam retreats are advertised everywhere. That isn’t meditation. That’s promoting rich people getaways, mostly scams that take up to 1-10 grand from people. I find it inauthentic . Like a greed grab. They have lots of free tracks which is good but they’re pretty bossy about making your own tracks. They tell you to write your bio description ‘in third person’ and I think those are highly weird, egotistical and strict rules for an open minded geared app. People should be able to describe themself as they see fit. There’s too much rigid control. Not flow. They took my advice of adding free group challenges, which is nice, but I can’t stand when an app redoes their entire interface with no tutorial or update on what’s changed. You just have to figure it out yourself. That’s my pet peeve with developers. No guidance. Ironic. Other than that I like the app. I don’t like how they allow you to “save your streak” like duolingo, another scam that cheats hard work an tricks you. If you use a streak freeze, that’s not a streak. Stop enabling cheating. I’m so sick of apps doing that. If you miss a day, your streak is over. No back ups. It’s just dishonest to those who value real progress. Also there should be emphasis that meditation progress grows without streaks too. They could do better.

insighttimer.title: Hard to get to the meditation part
insighttimer.content:
Hello. Six years using this app pretty infrequently during times when I needed help to get peaceful.

Lately, it has become the very thing that drives so much mental fray. I did not love the idea of “streaks” or at least I thought it would be great if this were a setting to be toggled. Now, when I open the app, I answer a forced survey so it can - without my asking - “tailor a plan” for me and ask for sixty bucks.

Such a mundane and easily overlooked thing, but I have answered this a dozen times. Then I go ahead to meditate how I was going to meditate without their “plan”. Everything wants a login, a paid subscription, an engagement tool, a place to boast how many days in a row you’ve kept a streak of mindfulness.

I know everyone has to beg these days to fund their little apps with their little features. Do that to newcomers or do it in a less obtrusive way than putting an obstacle between me and my peace every time I launch. I don’t care how quickly you can answer and then ignore the forced feedback. Cut it out.

Highly, highly recommend!

balance.title: Great content, but why is Facebook here?
balance.content:
I genuinely love what Balance has built. The voice options are excellent, the recordings feel polished and high quality, and being able to choose the length of a session makes it easy to fit into any day. What really sets it apart is how interactive the meditations feel. The app design makes the experience feel personal in a way most meditation apps don't.

Which is why I was disappointed to discover (via iPhone's App Privacy Report) that the app pings ep2.facebook.com every single time it opens. I'm a paying subscriber. There are no ads. So why is Meta receiving a signal every time I launch a meditation app?

This isn't a theoretical concern. Facebook's SDK embedded in third-party apps is a well-documented way Meta builds profiles on people across the internet, even outside their own platforms. For a wellness app, one people use precisely because they're trying to decompress and disconnect, this feels like a significant mismatch of values.

I'd love to see Balance offer paid subscribers an opt-out of all third-party SDKs, or at minimum publish a clear explanation of why the Meta SDK is present and what data is actually shared. Until then, I'll be switching to an alternative, which is a shame because the content itself is genuinely top-tier.

balance.title: Inclusive Mediation App
balance.content: I really found the Balance app to stand out from the rest. Meditation and breathwork are not one-size-fits-all, so the fact that you can start at a very beginner level and choose a voice that is actually calming for you is really stellar. What this app understands that others don’t is that one voice or similar voices can sometimes be triggering for the rest of us. We can experience the opposite of calm, and instead, it could be anxiety-inducing. So the fact that you can have options around what you need to hear to actually enter into a state of calmness, meditation, and reflection is really important. I also think it’s great that you can find something for the moment you are in and that addresses your needs. You can start and work your way through levels and trainings, or do a single and move on. This app has really been clutch for me during challenging moments in my life.

balance.title: this app changed my life for the better and i'm so grateful
balance.content:
i'm never one to write reviews on things but this app has changed my life for the better and I am so grateful for it. I've used meditation apps like headspace before but balance makes meditation so much more personal and accessible than any other meditation app has. 

I love the feeling of accomplishment I get after completing a 10 series plan and I love the grounding sense of calm I get from just 5-10 minutes of completing one of the single lessons. I tell anyone who will listen about this app and I recommend it to everyone. Meditation is a life changing habit and balance makes it so you learn more about meditation every time you use it. 

Sometimes it's hard to see a difference in yourself before and after meditating but I could really tell when I was a barista and I would wake up at 4:30 and open the coffee shop at 6 am by myself. I started getting there early enough to have 10 minutes before open to meditate. Before meditation, I would be pretty cranky and short with the customers and a little anxious and self conscious. After I started meditating, I would have way more patience and self confidence. I'd be more likely to engage with the customers and I would feel much more at ease. Using this app helped me foster a community instead of trudge through a shift. 

I appreciate the customization of the lessons, the reminders you can set up, and the little lessons before each meditation. It's such a well thought out and intentional design that brings as much comfort as each meditation does. I bought the lifetime membership and it's the best purchase I could've made. 

I do wish they would bring back the year long free trial, or at least extend it to 6 or even 3 months. Telling my friends they can have a 1 month trial always get the same "maybe" answer which I know means no /: I understand, but I really appreciated that it used to be so accessible.

I don't know who really reads reviews but if you actually read all of this, please try this app out. start with the foundations plans and see where it takes you :)

balance.title: My Favorite Meditation App
balance.content: There are so many meditation apps with similar offerings. What I enjoy most about my experience with Balance is the intuitive interface of the app. It’s simple and not overstimulating and easy to navigate. I enjoy the level based and skill based structure of the programs. It helps me to hone specific techniques and level up as I practice. This app really dives into the technical side of meditation so the programs offer a wide variety of applications and a wide variety of different techniques. I enjoy the coaches (Ofusu is my personal favorite) and how they adjust their approach based on your input into the app. It remembers the answers and facts you input and the programs get adjusted accordingly. It’s a really smart meditation app and has a feeling of aliveness, if that makes sense. It has helped me tremendously to expand my practice and has helped me be mindful in my moment by moment living. Presence is the word I would use. I’m happy I paid for the subscription and applied myself to the practice.

balance.title: I love this app but I do have a couple recommendations…

I use this app every night and day; from sleep meditations, to focusing while writing or working.  
I enjoy that you can make some meditations longer but I do think adding 1.5hrs or 2hrs options would be not only awesome but very beneficial. Only because sometimes an hour is too little for me, especially on the nights when I struggle to get to sleep. 
 I also don’t want to have my phone playing for 3 hours if I’m sleeping. Which totally isn’t the worst but I personally feel like It would be great to have more options especially if it isn’t guided. 
I feel like the mood check in with meditation should be more in-depth. It would be really interesting to keep track of moods on this app with the meditations as well to really see where the mind goes and how you feel before and after the meditations. I also feel like it would make me want to utilize it more if I knew the consistency of it would weight out the gratification that I’m seeking. 
Lastly, have you considered adding more voices to the guided meditations? 
I always listen to Leah but It would be awesome to hear another voice besides hers or ofosu. 
Thank you for taking the time to read this. Again I love
Your app, these are just somethings I have noticed while using it.

balance.title: LOVE THIS APP -
balance.content:
Leah is the best narrator, I love the personalization of the plans. 

To get you started, here are My Favorite Listens:

Midday Rest (these 5 minutes hit hard when I’m on my 30-minute lunch break and don’t have time for a nap)

Nap (available in 15 minutes to 3 hours- the 15 min is a godsend when I need to fully reset on my lunch break, the 45 minute option come in handy when it’s almost time for another activity, like Dodgeball, but I’m all wound up from my day)

Sick Day (this actually helped me accept sickness, rest, and recovery)

Up At Night (number one pick for falling asleep fast)

Anxiety (lay down with the bad boy for 15 minutes and emerge refreshed, breathing, balanced)

Embrace Change 10 Day Plan (I’m only on day 7 after starting a few moths ago, but it’s helped so much with my mindset around accepting things that are beyond my control and taking control of the things in my power.  It’s a key player in the moves I’m making to become self-employed again.)

Confidence 10 Day Plan (who knew doing a power pose while laying down could be so effective?!)

Facing Fear 10 Day Plan (the first full plan I completed.  It changed my life.  I wouldn’t be writing you today without it, nor would I have made such strides in finding my queer community in Boston, making more friends than I can count in 2024 and finally dating women. Downloading the app medito and using it was such a lovely experience! I previously downloaded two other meditation apps, but you had to pay to even have a trial of the app, so logging into this app and having it say “meditation should cost nothing but time” was so nice! I love how visually appealing the app is, with the little emojis, and how clear everything is with 8 folders right at the top of your screen for optimal origination with different practices for things like daily, sleep, emergency, favorite, challenges and even courses on meditation. There is featured section, and a quote, with some merchandise to donate to the non-profit organization that runs this app, so everything is very neat which is super helpful, and I know where everything is! I particularly like the UCLA guided meditations, as a college student, as the verity piques my interest.

Throughout the past few days, I have done some of the meditations and it really feels like they have a practice for everything! There was a folder for societal crisis, which I think much of the country has been feeling this year, and their self-care meditation helped me focus on ways I can show myself love during this stressful time. I also did one from the stress and anxiety set that was for finding peace in the present moment, and it was so lovely to take time out of a stressful academic day just to focus on the moment right there instead of being so caught up in the future. 

I think the way this app works is very adjacent to the things I am learning in my abnormal psychology class at university. The idea that anxiety is worrisome thoughts about the future can be helped by these meditations that help you soak up the present moment like the practice I did. In class we also discussed how breathing exercises can help slow down can help slow down heart high rate, which can be a physical manifestation of anxiety. The breathing exercises, most commonly where I was instructed to take deep slow breaths in and hold, really helped my heart rate go down as I was paying attention to it with my fit bit. Slow breathing was the key and it seemed to regulate my body, lessening the anxious build up I felt in my chest. This app helps to lower the stress and worry about the future that anxiety comes with and helps quiet and ease the mind by focusing on breath, allowing for a more relaxed present state of mind.
