I was sitting in my bathroom right at the edge of a panic attack and after the three minute session, my panic was gone and I felt relaxed. It’s hard to explain to someone the mental struggle you go through of anxiety, OCD, and panic attacks. On the outside it seems like everything is normal to other people like there’s nothing wrong and it seems like it would be obvious that nothing is truly wrong. But on the inside you’re struggling. Getting tunnel vision and feeling like you’re gonna die. This app has helped me daily and I’m forever thankful. The more you meditate the more it becomes a mental habit and the more it builds up the chemicals inside of you that help you calm yourself and combat the feelings that you have. I will always support this app and recommend it to anyone who needs help.

wakingup.title: Mediation as it should be practiced
wakingup.content: Having attempted meditation over the past few years, I had come to believe that mindfulness was primarily a focusing exercise. You learn to focus on breathing, to the exclusion of all else, and learn to apply this skill more generally. All the other impacts others described seemed down stream of this focus, and those that weren’t I believed to be made up. After giving this app a few months, I can say that I was completely incorrect. I won’t argue for it here, but meditation is the practice of “self”-knowledge (and for those who have worked through the courses I use the word self generously here). It is a genuinely profound experience to realize you have lived your entire being drowned in thought, and to finally hear that torrent of noise as it is. The meditation practices provided here do really give the sense of “waking up”, for the first time. I would recommend this practice to anyone, I think Harris and the other instructors on here do a very good job, and there are a wide variety of courses focusing on Cognitive behavioral therapy, more spiritual versions of meditation, self knowledge, gratitude, analyzing consciousness. Meditation is much more expansive than I thought it was. This may sound unrealistic to those who haven’t tried it (it certainly was to me). Just try going in with an open mind, I feel highly confident it will change how you see yourself and the world.

wakingup.title: Life Changibg
wakingup.content:
I’ve struggled with mental health issues my entire life and have spent over a decade exploring different therapy modalities to manage all of the challenges of life (CBT, ACT, DBT, etc.). I can confidently say that this app has had the most positive impact on my mental health than anything else I’ve ever done. 

I’ve tried other mediation tools like Headspace and Calm in the past but could never stick with them. Sam’s method is completely different than any other app out there, and after following the 30 day introductory course I was hooked and have been a daily user for a year now. 

Outside of the guided meditations I think what sets this app apart is all of the talks and other content to explore, most of which are chunked into 5min vignettes to make digesting them easy. I especially enjoy the teachings of Joseph Goldstein who I listen to almost daily. 

There’s a 30 day free trial with structured lessons so there’s no thinking about where to begin. I think everyone should at least give it a shot for 30 days and I guarantee you’ll start to see the benefits!

wakingup.content: Meditation was one of my goals for this year. It was overwhelming seeing the dozens of meditation apps available and not knowing which one would work for me. What drew me to this app was the fact that it is founded by neuroscientists and psychologists, with techniques and practices based on science. Sam’s introductory course really guided me calmly into the world of meditation and I automatically began feeling grounded, present and at peace. There are countless different courses to choose from and I love the daily quotes, moments and clips to ponder. It’s really given me such a deeper perspective on my being present and mindful in my daily life and I can’t see my life without meditation now. I highly recommend Waking Up if you’re wanting to start meditating or even if you’re a long time meditator. There’s something here for everyone to experience, learn and enjoy.

wakingup.title: Go-to!

It’s truly unbelievable that I am able to tap into just about any and every teaching I desire, using this app. I finally made the leap from just using it for theory study and actually started using the guided meditations and timer. The app is like having a teacher always accessible and it seems to be working for me in a similar way as meeting with teachers in the past. I am undeniably grateful jto have access to this bank of wisdom. Interesting, this is my review from the first time I used waking up. It mostly still applies accurately except I have to admit, it is not the same as being with my teacher face to face. I’m okay with that though. I’ll just become ever more patient.

wakingup.title: Waking Up: A Meditation App for People Who Don’t Like Meditation Apps
wakingup.content:
Waking Up is the rare meditation app that treats you like an adult. No soft-focus clichés, no mystical promises, no “just breathe and manifest” fluff. It’s built for people who want clarity, not incense; insight, not slogans.

What makes it stand out is its intellectual honesty. Every lesson, practice, and lecture is grounded in clear reasoning and direct experience. Instead of trying to soothe you with platitudes, it teaches you how the mind actually works—and how to relate to it with precision and calm. The result is a practice that feels clean, rigorous, and refreshingly free of spiritual theatrics.

The daily meditations are concise and purposeful. The theory sections are surprisingly deep without ever drifting into jargon. And the broader curriculum—covering everything from non-duality to cognitive science—gives you a framework for understanding consciousness that’s both accessible and profound.

If you’ve ever bounced off traditional meditation apps because they felt too sentimental, too vague, or too performative, Waking Up is the antidote. It’s meditation for the rational mind: structured, thoughtful, and genuinely transformative.

A rare example of an app that respects your intelligence while helping you build a calmer, clearer inner life.

wakingup.title: Not for me
wakingup.content: I wish the content were as good as the ads. Not as self reflective behavioral change motivational speech as I thought it was (based on the ads). More like a meditation alarm with extra educational content. I think I would do better to listen to a chapter of a self help book everyday. I cancelled 4 days too late from the free trial and got charged for a year, but the developer reached out to me to refund me (unsolicited). I believe this developer is responsive and actively engaged in listening to feedback and improving the app to become what is most valued by its customers.

wakingup.title: You only have your mind - why not work to understand and appreciate it?

But all I hear is Sam’s voice interrupting every few seconds and it drives me crazy and is all I can think about. “When is Sam going to interrupt, it’s been awkwardly silent for three seconds” We never get time to settle in to what is being asked to try. Perhaps that would make the lessons too long and people wouldn’t make time for it. So rather than cut out Sam’s incessant chatter which is often trivial, the developers cut out the actual meditation time. I’m deleting the app and cannot believe people will subscribe for $150/!year. It’s all here and present and free.

wakingup.title: I’m Waking Up
wakingup.content: I’m not writing this to negatively talk about other meditation apps, because I do think they have helped me too, and I think they are probably good for certain people, but this app, compared to others, has changed me more in my day to day living. This one genuinely feels like I’m “rewiring my brain” to experience the world differently. Where other apps utilize (even similar techniques) meditation to reduce stress and anxiety—which is helpful—, Waking Up puts it in a way that makes the experience of meditation easier. I always felt like I was meditating wrong until using this app. Something about how the guided practices are worded, I feel like I have finally understood that there is no “wrong” way to do it. It’s just acknowledging what is happening and that’s it. Simple. I truly feel like I’m waking up from the sleep I’ve been in. I also think that the interface is helpful; other apps have given too many options, like how long I want the meditation to be, for example, but Waking Up just has it there, and I don’t feel like I’m not taking my practice seriously if I choose a 3 or 5 minute meditation as opposed to a 10 or 20 minute one. It’s whatever time it is and I don’t have to make any decision about how much I’m dedicating to the practice. The content is also so beneficial in helping the intellectual, spiritual, emotional bodies. I love all of it truly. Such a great app! Couldn’t recommend it more.

wakingup.content:
I wish the app had a monthly payment option instead of just an annual one. There’s no demo, so I can’t listen to any talks or information without paying for a subscription. 

It would be great if the team could include a small free section to check out the content without having to enter payment info first!

wakingup.title: LIFE CHANGING!
wakingup.content: Waking up has been absolutely life changing for me.  Thanks Sam and Team!  The App is everything you want it to be and so much more. There’s so much valuable information on mindfulness right here.

wakingup.title: Business Owner
wakingup.content:
I began this meditation journey in 1975, attending transcendental meditation classes while still in high school. It had a profound impact on my outlook on life. 
During college I didn’t maintain the practice but certainly drew from the experience and have all along. 
This is the first time in a very long time that I’ve had 
guided meditations. 
It is very helpful and I look forward to the experience each day. 
It has reawakened me!
Thank you, thank you Sam.

wakingup.title: Master Class
wakingup.content: Simply, this app changed my life.  I’m grateful for wisdom and guidance.

wakingup.title: Owner of this app is vile
wakingup.content: Worthless app and the owner preaches war while he makes money off of rubes

wakingup.title: Transformative App
wakingup.content: Waking up has been the most transformative app I’ve ever used in my lifetime. I have found tremendous peace and wisdom in its lessons and daily meditations. I highly recommend it to anyone who is looking to cultivate equanimity and carve out space and time for reflection amidst the busyness of our modern lives.

wakingup.title: Great Place To Grow!
wakingup.content: I enjoy learning from experienced practitioners. Very grateful for the wisdom shared.

wakingup.title: It doesn't stay open.
wakingup.content: I'd be more than happy to pay for this in the long-term if it stayed open.

wakingup.title: I have learned a lot.
wakingup.content: I never did much meditation so I really didn’t know what to expect. I’ve been doing waking up pretty consistently for a while now. It’s very interesting and has some very amazing insights on the mind. It is definitely worth every penny. I spent on it and I meditate every morning now I’ve seen a difference in my daily life from how I react to Tough situations. 10 out of 10 I would recommend give it a try!

wakingup.title: Surprising
wakingup.content: In short, I have no use for the religious/dogmatic approach to…anything, really, but especially spirituality. I am decidedly secular in my approach to the world, and I did not think a practice of this sort would interest me at all, but I gave the free trial an honest chance, and it won me over. There is a TON of content here, and I like be that there are short sessions, long sessions, series on lots of concepts, and very little in the way of religion, not really Buddhism (in the formal sense). I don’t know much about this world of meditation, and I am allergic to anything that feels or sounds woo-woo/new age. So I was surprised to find this app helpful, useful, and increasingly interesting. At the end of my trial, I signed up for a year and I am looking forward to learning as much as I can along the way. I do think it could improve my quality of life, so that’s what I am working towards.

wakingup.title: Too costly
wakingup.content: Good just expensive cheaper options or YouTube

wakingup.title: Great concept, but very very buggy
wakingup.content:
Sam has done a great job with the content and the daily meditations, however the bugginess off the app often makes it hard to love the app AND makes it harder to meditate.

The bugs I have the most issue with are:
1. The background music drops of sporadically, and seems to be dependent on a perfect internet connection, even for downloaded sessions 
2. The app sporadically loses the ability to keep playing the meditation session when the phone screen turns off. Requiring me to constantly unpause 
3. When the background music sporadically stops during a meditation session, I can’t be sure if it’s just the music or #2 in the list.

wakingup.title: Incredible guided meditation and incredible talks
wakingup.content: From the daily meditations to the philosophical talks in their archive. Every part of this app has helped calm my mind and assist my sense of attention

wakingup.title: Beautiful
wakingup.content: Loving this app so far. Love that they offer discounts for those struggling. Thank you waking up folks

wakingup.title: Life altering
wakingup.content: I have been a Christian for many years now, and my faith has helped me and guided me so much. I can’t explain how grateful I am to God. However, I still struggled with anxiety and overthinking. This app and meditation has not replaced my faith but has instead complemented it and has helped me immensely in freeing my mind and bringing me so much more fullness of life in the present moment.

wakingup.title: the one app that i have stuck with
wakingup.content: i’m a college student that wanted to incorporate meditation in my routine to help with the daily stresses of life. i have tried so many apps in the past that i could not stick with or afford the paid subscription. i applied for the free subscription for this app, and i have been using it every morning and just finished the starter meditation program!! i’m now doing the daily meditation. it has helped me feel so much better and even though i still have trouble understanding how to meditate, it has improved significantly since the start. i will say at the start i sometimes missed a few days or was inconsistent, but it slowly built into a habit after pushing myself to make it a daily thing to do in the morning. the starter program is very beneficial for everyone because it starts from zero and only takes 10 minutes daily. highly recommend!!

wakingup.title: Meditations pausing on screen lock
wakingup.content:
Great content, no qualms with that. However keep running into an issue where I will do a session, and then at some point I’ll realize the screen is locked and the audio is paused. 

This is frustrating because the sessions take longer than expected, and it’s distracting to have to check my phone occasionally to
make sure it’s not paused.

Thanks devs for your work on this, I appreciate it!

wakingup.title: Broad Meditation Horizons
wakingup.content: An easy interface and beautiful graphics set the tone for daily mediation guided by a collection of experienced teachers. The variety of voices and lack of a single doctrine gives the site an liberal arts look and feel. I have become a daily user and life is happily more moderate.

wakingup.title: Life altering.
wakingup.content: As a long time yogi, I would have not made the rapid progress on my path without the assistance and loving support of this app. I will be a lifetime user and will happily transition from a scholarship recipient to a grateful paying student. It's that good.

wakingup.title: Keeps me consistent.
wakingup.content: Fun variety and keeps me consistent.

wakingup.title: Thoughts
wakingup.content: Finished the intro course, it is marvelous that I could have gone my whole life without ever once given any consideration to my own thoughts. My thoughts color my whole experience and I never once until now stopped to observe them and realize that they are the source of any suffering.(not that thoughts are useless on the contrary)

wakingup.title: Amazing app
wakingup.content: I downloaded this during my yoga teacher training in 2020 because we were told to meditate at least 10 minutes every morning and I didn’t know how. Whenever I used this app regularly since then, little miracles seemed to keep happening where my interactions became more compassionate and thoughtful, I felt more in control of my actions and my destiny, and I was able to reach a meditative state super fast in savasana or just sitting outside. I can’t wait to jump back in after all these years. I’m glad I can pay for a membership now but it was still available to me when I really couldn’t. Amazing

wakingup.title: Thank you!
wakingup.content: The Waking Up app has been an absolute game-changer! It has been truly transformative. I’m immensely grateful to Sam, the entire Waking Up team, and everyone who has contributed to the app for providing such a wealth of knowledge to the public. Their approach to mindfulness, meditation, and self-awareness has not only deepened my understanding of Eastern Philosophy and meditation, but has also enhanced my overall well-being. This app has become an essential tool in my journey toward personal growth, and I can't recommend it highly enough.

wakingup.title: No Words
wakingup.content: There really are no words to describe what Waking Up has given me. I recommend this app to anyone and everyone that is ready to grow, expand, or embrace “new” states of consciousness.

wakingup.title: A good start
wakingup.content: I just finished the introductory course of the waking up app. It’s a great in that the app doesn’t just have a daily meditation session for you. I learned about stoicism from some Scottish guy and I’ve also been using the yoga nidra sessions. I recommend this app to anyone that’s interested in learning.

wakingup.title: This app saved my life multiple times
wakingup.content: The insights I’ve gained from this forever changed my perspective on reality and consciousness. It’s been a reliable friend during dark times and a way to appreciate the world more during good times.

wakingup.title: Member Since 2021
wakingup.content: This is a mindfulness app that is incredibly comprehensive and infinitely useful. If you’re serious about meditation and self awareness this is for you.

wakingup.title: Depth & Wisdom
wakingup.content: Thank you for creating a meditation app focused on deeper wisdom and depth. The effort your team has made to allow me to subscribe despite the steep costs shows me the care you have for spreading these teachings. I’ve candidly found some of the meditations outside of Sam Harris more aligned with my path and am so glad for the diverse yet quality range that exists here. What an amazing moment this is!

wakingup.title: Little by little and day by day
wakingup.content: I was living in constant mental chaos caused by my own thoughts. After years of therapy, I was still seeking a practice to handle the day-to-day minutiae that was keeping me up at night and creeping into my weekend mind. I completed the 28-day intro course and developed a sense of calm/control that I had been seeking. I meditate now because it allows me to look into my own thoughts, without judgment. I don’t feel I have to “turn off my brain” but rather I just have to examine it. I haven’t had any huge revelations or life changing transformations. I just have a greater sense of my mind each day and each moment. But I learned that this simplicity is the transformation I was seeking. Waking Up is approachable and that’s why I keep coming back every day.

wakingup.title: Much more than Meditation!
wakingup.content: A friend sent me the free 30 day course after I had found myself blindsided in some unexpected hardship. I’ve never practiced mediation on the reg and this app has single handily CHANGED MY LIFE. Sam teaches me everyday in 10 min sessions and I’ll never be able to thank him enough! I find myself feeling well and whole again. Although I am doing many things and taking many paths to get better I credit most of my wellbeing to my 10 minute meditation practice. Our brain is our control center people! Meditation is medicine and fuel for a healthy one. Thank you Sam, for this treasure of an app.

wakingup.title: Life changing
wakingup.content: The only mediation app that I like. It’s a game changer

wakingup.title: Life changing
wakingup.content: After inauguration day, and the fires in California, Sam decided to speak on meditation and mindfulness rather than either of those two catastrophic events. This was the domino leading me to using the free trial on this app. This has been transformative for me in work, relationships, and idle times. Probably one of the simplest and easiest things you can do to drastically improve your life. This is like Ozempic or steroids for your brain and consciousness. Get after it.

wakingup.title: The very best
wakingup.content: I look forward to my daily meditation every day. Thank you!

wakingup.title: Will positively impact your life greatly
wakingup.content: I have been using the Waking Up app for over a year now, and it is by far my most used and most valuable service I have on my phone. The difference in how I think, feel, and act on a day that I use this app versus a day that I don’t is huge. And when I do use the app, I am always thinking, feeling, and acting, in a more positive manner. This app will make your life better.

wakingup.title: Excellent introductory course and so much more
wakingup.content: An excellent source of information and what clearly stands out is the 30 day introduction course. Each ‘day’ is an experience of meditation while introducing you to new skills followed by reasoning, questioning and theory as to the why. It takes less than 30 minutes and feels so productive in terms of learning. Leaving you with profound ideas and concepts.

wakingup.title: An endless well of wisdom and meditations.
wakingup.content: In a world that is saturated with charlatan teachers and woo woo concepts, Sam has curated what feels like an endless collection of meditations, lectures and interviews that strike  at the heart of real eastern philosophical teachings. These teaching are not only palatable for western minds but bridge the gap between ancient East and the rest of the world. As a beginner to meditation, I cannot express how thankful I am for the Waking Up app and the wisdom, insight and purity it consists of. It has quite literally saved and changed my life for the better. I cannot say enough good about it. Thank you, thank you, thank you.

wakingup.title: Just try it
wakingup.content: If you’re reading this, you’re probably curious about meditation and mindfulness. Just give it a shot, you won’t regret it.

wakingup.title: Transcriptions
wakingup.content: Please, most if not all the audio content available should have a transcription for further review.

wakingup.title: The only Meditation App that resonates with me
wakingup.content: This app is worth being a paid member for life. It’s life changing. I cannot describe the positive aspects and things I’ve learned in just a month using the Waking up App. It makes me view everything different in the best way possible. I live in a rural area where meditation isn’t common  or accessible in person. This app makes me want to take notes because there’s always golden pieces of information that make the experience and perception life changing.

wakingup.title: Daily alignment and support
wakingup.content: Love this app and Sam’s guidance as a support to come home to myself every day.

wakingup.title: Way too expensive
wakingup.content: Not worth the money

wakingup.title: Theory and Practice In One Place
wakingup.content: I learned of the app listening to Harris’s podcast one day.  I was intrigued by the essay he read discussing our relationship to our mind and thought.  I signed up for the trial and have been using the app daily for over a month.  I particularly like the recordings on meditation theory that accompany each daily meditation.  I have finished the intro course and am looking forward to trying meditations available from other teachers as well as Sam’s.

wakingup.title: Love to Sam Harris
wakingup.content: I’m not sure if I would have begun the practice of meditation without Sam Harris’s insight, explained in a way I could absorb. It clicked. I am consciousness. Freedom. All my love to the creators and teachers found here.

wakingup.title: A Game Changer!
wakingup.content:
What a blessing to have found this app and be slowly walking the path now of meditation.  I’ve been called to begin practicing for some time, and it was this app & Sam Harris and his wonderful way with language that has helped me begin to make small breakthroughs in what was initially a very intimidating project of beginning.  
Eternally grateful to him & the team at Waking Up!  Keep up the awesome work!

wakingup.title: Feels elitist to me
wakingup.content: I have meditated for years, and used many different apps. I recently tried this based on a recommendation. I liked the introductory course as a refresher of the basics of mindfulness and purchased the subscription. I like the moments, lessons, etc.  However, I have found some of the programming to feel elitist in two ways. First, whenever there are examples given of someone’s work, they all seem to be things that require extensive formal education, such as professor, inventor, etc. I myself have graduate degrees, but this vibe still bothers me. In addition, very little in this program seems to acknowledge the myriad of neurodivergent and mental health issues that arise in a meditative practice, whether it is forms of depression, anxiety, OCD, ADHD, PTSD, autism spectrum, etc., etc. Personally, I feel like I’ve gotten just as much out of apps are available for free or a lower fee and that feel more inclusive. I would not re-subscribe.

wakingup.title: Generous and brilliant
wakingup.content: What Sam has created is such a beautiful support in these perilous times of illusion and anxiety. The app works extremely well and his sharing of a vast and varied library of guidance and suggestions for a clearer path is very generous. I can’t thank him and his team enough and am very grateful for his gift.

wakingup.title: Powerful
wakingup.content: This app has helped me build a consistent meditation practice over the last few years. I have tried so many apps and meditation programs and nothing comes even close to the scope of Waking Up. It has helped with my life long battle with depression and ADHD. I don’t know what I would do if there wasn’t Waking Up. Thank you Sam for being who you are.

wakingup.title: So grateful for Sam’s work
wakingup.content: I adore all planks of Sam’s work and feel my life has improved as a result of tuning into him over the years. I don’t spend as much time on Waking Up as I would like—it doesn’t have quite the same allure as when a new Making Sense podcast drops. But, every time I do, I feel the better for it. I especially love and have made good use of the Moments feature—they always seem to arrive at the perfect moment to help make life’s difficulties seem less intractable.

wakingup.title: I love Waking Up
wakingup.content: This app helped me understand meditating and so many other concepts. I love my daily meditations and sleep meditations the most. You need this app!

wakingup.title: Amazing App
wakingup.content: This app has helped me enter into a meditation practice that I have always wanted to have. The intro course really helped me develop basic skills to feel confident to keep coming back to practice everyday. I’m really grateful for the app, Sam, and all who have helped put this together. Thank you

wakingup.title: It’s awesome but here are some expectations
wakingup.content: It’s really enjoyable the way Sam teaches it. The intro series, which is about 28 different guided practices, starts off simple then gets fairly advanced and even a bit confusing sometimes, so there’s nothing wrong with repeating the more basic ones (the first ten or so) over and over, and once you get the basic idea of these, even practicing them on your own some. It can take years to get really good at this stuff and to understand the more abstract concepts, but benefits can be seen almost immediately upon starting, and the journey is actually really enjoyable.

wakingup.title: Makes meditation approachable and enjoyable
wakingup.content: I’ve always struggled with meditation as I thought it was about clearing your head and thinking about nothing. Sam Harris has taught me how to meditate in an approaching, understanding, and forgiving manner. Furthermore, the support crew are very understanding and offer scholarships to help make membership affordable for all. I couldn’t recommend this app more!

wakingup.title: May Literally Change Your Life
wakingup.content: I’ve tried to get into meditation multiple times in my life, but it never completely clicked for me. This app is by far the best introduction to mindfulness and meditation that I’ve done. Sam’s intro course introduces the concepts and build upon them in a nearly perfect and very intuitive way. 6 months later I can say this app changed my life and will continue to. Highly recommend for anyone curious about mindfulness and meditation.

wakingup.title: Learn to meditate to be less upset about Sam Harris
wakingup.content:
Great teacher
Just found out what a racist this influential man is. Everyone is flawed and has their blind spots but ugh. Glad to have the app to work on not being upset and disgusted about that.  Grateful someone was willing to invest so much time learning nondual meditation so they can sell it  out to the masses. Happy to be able to buy. There’s no other way I could have accessed this knowledge.
Like everything else about this, what a paradox.

wakingup.title: Succint and Enlightening
wakingup.content:
This goes way beyond mere stress reduction or relaxation. WakingUp is a cult free and time efficient way to learn the deeper meaning and value of meditation. 

I did years of vipassana practice but Sam explained the concepts more effectively and understandably than I had ever heard. 

The course is easy to incorporate into a modern urban lifestyle and the App is fairly easy to navigate, although it does take  bit of tapping around once you’re past the first 28 day intro course.  

The support is excellent, my questions were answered promptly by a real human being typing US English, I really appreciated that.

wakingup.title: Habit turns into a practice
wakingup.content: The WU app has enabled me to have a meditation practice

wakingup.title: Waking up
wakingup.content: The app dives into mindfulness, philosophy and the nature of consciousness using an approach based in theory and practice and meditations. It incorporates interviews and conversations with philosophers, neuroscientists, and spiritual teachers.   The interface is simple and intuitive. I find Waking Up indispensable.

wakingup.title: Life changing
wakingup.content: If you are experienced or new to meditation, try waking up! Absolutely life changing.

wakingup.title: Changing my life moment by moment
wakingup.content: There are too many good things to say. Each day, I get a “Moment” sent to my phone that helps me reframe my experience, or reminds me of something valuable. There are countless playlists for enhancing mindfulness with meditation practice, theory, Q & A, recorded conversations with experts. The app presents me with endless opportunities to learn and grow.

wakingup.title: So grateful for this app!
wakingup.content: I have just started my journey with meditation using this app. So far what is being taught makes much more sense than trying it on my own. Thank you so much!

wakingup.title: Best meditation app
wakingup.content: I love the perspective and how theory and meditation are combined everyday. It is also very short sessions so easy to get used to. I always had a hard time to do regular meditation but this app motivates me a lot.

wakingup.title: Life changing
wakingup.content: I am so grateful the offer to have this app in my life.

wakingup.title: Smile
wakingup.content: This app helps me to enjoy my life more by teaching me how to put a smile in my mind.

wakingup.title: Life Changing
wakingup.content: Of all the apps out there, this one is most useful to me so far. It has lots of features and contents to allow the user to choose a path for developing the practice.

wakingup.title: Genuine
wakingup.content: Sam has such a genuine demeanor about mindfulness and presenting it in an understandable and comprehensible manner. Whether a yogi or a novice, much can be learned from this app. The content is a phenomenal resource for anyone interested in learning. He has a way of explaining meditation, the importance of mindfulness and his own lived experience, that captures attention.

wakingup.title: Improves my life
wakingup.content: The insights, experiences and guidance I have received from this app are invaluable. I abide better. Even when I am swept away by stress, I can retrieve myself more readily. I’ve been through vast life changes since I started meditating with Waking Up more than 5 years ago, and it has been a sort of home. As fires rage and everyone is losing their cool, even as my heart was figuratively ripped from my chest, I had and have a place to come back to. The strangest thing is it might not be a place, at all. Thanks, Sam.

wakingup.title: Thanks
wakingup.content: Just what I needed to get me meditating. Retirement has been difficult but I’m adding activities and beginning to enjoy life. Loving your podcast also. My new voice of reason.

wakingup.title: Amazing
wakingup.content: The perspective and conscious realization that is constantly being realized through awareness hasn’t really been done until Sam Harris introduced his in depth meditations and walkthroughs mentioned here

wakingup.title: The best meditation app I have used
wakingup.content: I started using the Waking Up app about two months ago and it has made a profoundly positive impact on my life. The guided meditations have really helped me to train my attention and provide me with more clarity and focus throughout the day. I never before realized the degree to which I was distracted and lost in thought in my day to day life, and merely being able to recognize THAT has helped me tremendously. Thank you Sam Harris and all of the developers who clearly put a lot of work into making this. I can’t recommend it enough

wakingup.title: No one should ever have to pay to meditate
wakingup.content:
Indeed I DID contact you more than once and you still told me I had to pay.  So now you are also liars.  He’s making money off you disguised as trying to help you!!
He’s a shell of his former self and has become lost.   He used to allow use of his app for free mediations if you couldn’t  afford it but stopped doing that.    
I don’t like people who get RICH off other peoples’ problems.

wakingup.title: Love it when it works.
wakingup.content: I love the idea of it but given how much I’m paying for membership I don’t feel like I should be having to hard close the app over and over again to be able to start a meditation. I will also have to set my own timer as sometimes the app will end unexpectedly during a meditation and you may find yourself late to your next appointment. So overall while the content is great, the actual functionality leaves a bit to be desired.

wakingup.title: Structured
wakingup.content:
I always struggled to meditate, but having unique daily guided sessions made it feel like I was doing it with someone. 

Great for building a habit.

wakingup.title: Sam Harris is FANTASTIC!!
wakingup.content: I have done many meditation apps and this one, actually with no music, really gets to the heart of the experience. I have loved every utterance from Sam since the release of his first book “the end of faith“. He is full of wisdom, intelligence, humor, insight and the list goes on. This meditation app is no exception! I highly recommend it!

wakingup.title: Phenomenal
wakingup.content: This app is great and is not limited to only meditation! Also, it’s intro course is far superior to Dan Harris’s “Happier” app. Highly recommend to anyone looking for guided mediation, mindfulness instruction, and yoga nidra.

wakingup.title: Practical and powerful meditation app!
wakingup.content: The Waking Up app offers so many insights from so many perspectives on mediation that it could be helpful to beginners and experienced mediators alike.

wakingup.title: No yoga voice
wakingup.content: It’s so nice to by guided through meditations that are not narrated in that breathy, artificially soft, voice that prevails on meditation apps and in yoga studios.

wakingup.title: Who knew?!
wakingup.content:
Who knew.  I didn’t, no idea how much peace and happiness was available from a simple 10-minute commitment per day.
Wow.  
I’ve found myself craving some “me” time, time to sit and reset, slow down, WATCH my mind at work.  That’s the practice.  Then, the GAME is much more enjoyable when I’ve honed my tool of mindfulness.  

Thanks to Sam and all the dedicated contributors in this wonderful app.  I’ve bought more than one book written by various teachers in the app, and shared the lessons with my children and coworkers.  

Wow.

wakingup.title: Amazing content
wakingup.content: I find the conversations very helpful when I need a little guidance in this Life.

wakingup.title: I am so grateful to have found gems like these in my life
wakingup.content: This app is honestly one of the most useful things I’ve come across. I use it all the time, the quotes, the “Take a Moment” feature, or just listening to the conversations like a podcast. Oh how it brings together so much! Psychology, therapy, yogic meditation, Indian traditions, philosophy, Stoicism in one place. It’s so much more than meditations, it’s about understanding yourself and the world better. Thank you so much Sam for this!

wakingup.title: Life changing yet approachable
wakingup.content: It’s growth and change right in my pocket. I’ve leaned on the app during moments of intense crisis (mental breakdowns, anxiety, depression, insomnia), it’s not a cure all as you have to be willing to put in the effort but the tools are all there. Waking up as helped me navigate and grow through life’s challenges. Offering perspective, reality, and timely wisdom.  I was a scholarship awardee due to financial challenges, and then became a full subscriber when I was able. The community app that accompanies this app has also been an engaging way to connected with other users. I highly recommend you try this app, and explore based on what you feel you need. I promise you’ll find that and more.

wakingup.title: Great content, poor utility
wakingup.content: I love the content on the app but it stops working about once every two weeks and I have to delete it and reinstall it to get it to work again. Frustrating.

wakingup.title: Bite size
wakingup.content:
I love that there Are daily 10min guided coherent meditations that I can access without scrolling, looking for, testing all sort of teachers (which is often a hit or miss in other apps). I like the consistent quality. Even if I don’t grasp all concepts (or agree with everything), I love the practices.
Reflections are great as well, so if u want to go deeper u can. Also the minute long “moments” are great.

I use this in addition to my usual meditation practices which are slightly different and usually go for 20min to 30min.

I was hesitant to try yet another meditation app, but was quickly convinced to integrate it into my life.

wakingup.title: Awesome!
wakingup.content: I have not become enlightened in 30 days but ove certainly noticed an improvement

wakingup.title: Great but too expensive
wakingup.content: I think this is a great app that could teach more people if it wasn’t so expensive. I have to really consider continuing because of the price.

wakingup.title: Mindfulness Without Borders!
wakingup.content: The title says it all-mindfulness training without the religious baggage taught by a real spiritual savant(that’s meant to be a compliment, Sam 😀).

wakingup.title: Most valuable app ever
wakingup.content: Waking Up is hands down the most valuable app I’ve ever encountered. From in-depth conversations with world-class experts to diverse meditation styles rooted in real practice and research, the content is unparalleled. Each session tackles important topics—procrastination, distraction, and pain management—and is both enlightening and practical. As someone dealing with ongoing health challenges, I’ve found genuine relief and support through its guided meditations for physical and emotional pain. With experts from Zen, Dzogchen, and beyond, Waking Up offers an inclusive, comprehensive path to mindfulness. I’ve recommended this app to everyone I know not for any incentives, but simply because I believe in its value.

wakingup.title: love letter to waking up crew
wakingup.content:
i am immensely grateful for the revitalized experience of daily living you furnish through teachings of this platform

please never stop

(pardon typos that follow)

—-

make room/
i know
the nuance
of feverish
contraction/
first from the
vantage point
of being captured/
in the present moment
ensnared by
the influence
of horse blinkers/
so restricting
sensory experience/
there is an
entire world
in the periphery
ceasing to exist/
having been 
made such a 
distant memory/
almost relegated
as an element of
imagination/
while the sear
of that brand
of anxiety/
freshly removed
from between the coals
and forcefully applied/
collapses all
of existence
into the ingress
of intolerable…
high pitched whines
and blindingly bright
convulsions of
the mind/
this is the forest
of misery
from which
the trees
cannot be seen
while in the thick of it/
even while unable
to expunge 
the catalogue
of catastrophic
drops in the gut
as such/
through the lens
of contemplative practice/
the key hole broadens 
to an open door/
grisly sensations
need not relinquish
for coordinates
located at my lonely
to grasp point 
of reference/
see self as set
of conditions
where these transient
elements collide/
furnishing them
ample room to rage/
and scale the 
crazy to apocalyptic/
with neither clinging
nor aversion
activated and engaged/
still in the forest
but catapulted
to an elevated position
from which valleys…
summits and rivers
remain visible/
make space 
for it all/
be taken by
and identify
with none/
dropping back
into the space
of consciousness/
there is
just this/

wakingup.title: Excellent Meditation App
wakingup.content: I joined for a free month a while back and I got a taste of the 28 introductory course with Sam Harris. I love his style of guided meditation, and that there’s time to sit quietly (I add his background music too), and also to contemplate the concepts he’s bringing to my attention. Now I’m in the daily guided meditations and I love that you can add minutes to them, in the middle of the meditation to have more time to sit. I’ve never been consistent at meditation and Sam’s app has been drawing me into it on a daily basis. I love it. Thank you!

wakingup.title: The most life-changing app I have ever used
wakingup.content: I had tried other meditation apps and enjoyed them. I was familiar with some of Sam’s work, and I had always respected his approach. So, I was curious to try Waking Up. To say it’s changed my life just doesn’t capture it. I started using it for meditation, but I have come to love all of the other content provided by the app. The conversations are powerful, in the way that Sam draws s much wisdom out of others. I also love the Life section that was added after I subscribed. There is so much practical wisdom for living a better life there from so many great teachers that I continue to grow from listening and implementing it. After a year, I got the lifetime subscription, and it’s been worth every penny.  I don’t think a day goes by that I don’t listen to something new on here, and I could see myself happily doing so for the rest of my life.

wakingup.title: Life Changing
wakingup.content: I can’t explain it, but Waking Up is a life changer. The saying “if you work it, it works” applies here. I am past the intro course and I wish the secondary courses were as structured. Also it would be awesome if we could add certain courses to our Home Screen. Thanks for it all, Sam.

wakingup.title: Excellent

wakingup.title: Epic. Absolutely epic.
wakingup.content:
I struggled to build and deepen my meditation practice with apps like Headspace and Calm, yet felt the call to explore consciousness and better understand the nature of my self and mind. This app was exactly perfect for me. 

It is enthralling and effective, and the skills it’s brought me have utterly transformed my experience of reality existence, and self, with nuggets that have led me to meaningful breakthroughs. 

Thanks for offering your insights, Sam!

wakingup.title: A simple approach to meditation
wakingup.content: I like the directness with which this program guides the meditator to the true nature of consciousness. The Introductory Course wastes no time in building the skills to gently inspect our awareness as we experience our senses, our bodily sensations, and, perhaps most importantly, our thoughts. This allows literally anyone to experience the profound difference between being lost in thought and witnessing thought.

Highly recommend! Thanks Sam.

wakingup.title: Invaluable

wakingup.title: My short review
wakingup.content: Sam Harris is the philosophical genius of our time. His rational world view and meditation has changed my life and will change yours given a chance. Read his books, join his Substack and his podcast.

wakingup.title: Equanimity
wakingup.content: By far the best mediation app. Teaches you not to achieve some ephemeral state, but how to live well in life, right here and now. Plus, tons of theory and conversations to keep you learning. Highly recommend ‘Deep Rest’ NSDR sessions with Kelly.

wakingup.title: Life changing

I had a positive experience with a colleague leading a Friday mediation practice and decided to commit more time to meditation. wakingup.title: Simply great!

wakingup.title: So happy this App is being used by so many people!
wakingup.content: This App has been such a help for me!

wakingup.title: Best “meditation “ app available.

Sam’s voice alone brings peace and calm to my day. The words and other thinkers that he chooses to provide us with are priceless. This app has helped me understand some of my actions and allowed me to change myself for the better. I wouldn’t choose any other app.

wakingup.title: Sam Harris is a great teacher!!

The talk was titled *The Path and Goal of Practice*. I’ve been reading Dzogchen and Mahamudra books since 1992 and own more books on non-dual awareness than I care to admit. But it wasn’t until I heard Sam teaching this lesson that it suddenly clicked for me. Thank you, Sam! I could say it a thousand times.  You are what’s great about this app. Your rational calm way of speaking is something I have a really had a lot of of my life.
I don’t have much more to say for now, but I’m sure this realization will increase in frequency over time. I can’t imagine being without this app at this point in my life.

wakingup.title: Great experience
wakingup.content: I was recommended this all by a dear friend of mine. I don’t consider myself a “avid meditator” but I have been meditating everyday for 10 minutes for about 2-3 years. I can honestly say that Sam’s guided meditations have helped me tremendously! Cannot recommend this app enough!

wakingup.title: Changed my life

I always thought that each piece of life has to carry certain emotions, that even certain interactions with people used to leave me a certain feeling or emotion or way to act —- this app has started to chip away at all these old patterns and really show me the beautiful quiet space in between my thoughts, my emotions, and my reality

wakingup.title: Sam Harris— Life changing!
wakingup.content:
I’ve tried many guided meditations on YouTube, and other apps such as Headspace. 

Waking up is practical, science WITH the eastern philosophy, and more than that: 

It’s progressively challenging. Sam’s beginner course teaches you WHY the breath is a good tool, and what it is that meditation seeks to ACHIEVE. And yet, so much more more than that. This review doesn’t give it justice. 

Stop thinking about it and get the 30 day trial. You will get so much out of it! 

Thank you Sam, for giving this practice a better structure, married with science, while still being deeply profound and transformative.

wakingup.title: The Best Meditation App
wakingup.content: I began using Sam’s meditation app about a year ago on and off, but around February of this year, I went through a major depression and used his app to pull me out of it. Today, I can honestly say I’m happier and more present in my life. I wake every morning and use Sam’s guided meditation. My only criticism is that I happen to believe in Free Will; my views align more with Daniel Dennett’s view than Sam’s, but I think Sam would appreciate someone from Dennett’s camp using his app. Overall, it’s a joy and pleasure to meditate with Sam every morning, and the countless additional meditations and lectures only enhance my understanding on how to live a more centered and present existence.

wakingup.title: I Finally Understand
wakingup.content: I started with the twenty-eight day introductory course and it has changed my life. I’ll spare you the detailed description but I encourage you to try it for yourself.

wakingup.title: Best meditation app ever

wakingup.title: A wonderful, life-changing app
wakingup.content: I find waking up to be the greatest app I have ever used and a truly life-changing experience. I struggled my entire life with a lot of stress, anxiety, and depression, and also was completely subsumed in many pursuits that didn’t really make me happy, but I didn’t have the awareness to see the mechanics of my own mind. Waking Up changed all of that for me by giving me the tools to observe my own experience. My entire sense of what life is about has changed for the better, and I’ve now recognized that the quality of my own mind is the basis of real contentment and well-being. I am immensely grateful to have had the chance to learn these truths and be able to apply them in my life, I would say that there has never been anything more important that I have ever experienced. thank you sincerely from the bottom of my heart for doing this work and helping people like me completely transform our lives for the better.

wakingup.title: Waking up is the best
wakingup.content:
I have tried a few different meditation apps, and I enjoy waking up the most. It has a way of really teaching you the fundamentals — not in a super time intensive way, but through practice. I felt like this meaty substance was missing from other apps and sessions in those apps.

One practical thing I’ve found in this app, and not others, is the direction of attention towards a given thought when the mind wonders. Paying attention to that thought and watching it unspool.

My practice with this app has helped me to become a more even keeled and present person. I highly recommend it.

wakingup.title: Incredible daily resource
wakingup.content:
Easily the most important app on my device.  The meditations are simple and concise yet varied and deep enough to keep your proficiency on awareness up to speed. That alone makes it worth it, but there is also content on “theory” and “life” separated into easily digestible segments.  These end up being just as essential to your spiritual and mental well-being as meditation practices are. 

The only drawback to all of this (and probably an unfair critique) is that it is all “audio”.  Specifically, the “theory” and “life” segments. That obviously makes it difficult to take notes and revisit important facts and arguments that you’d like to commit to memory.  But, most of this content is written by the guest speakers who wrote book(s) on the content they’re sharing anyways on the app (e.g. Matthew Walker, Cal Newport, etc). Even if this remains an audio only app for the next decade or two, it’s still the most important one on my device.

wakingup.title: Thank you brother / sisters, truly life changing
wakingup.content: Sam and team. Thank you so much. I wish I look each and every one of you in the eye and express my gratitude, but I can’t. It’s exponential, beyond expression. You’ve changed my life in ways I can’t express. I love you all. Thank you for the knowledge and the persistent repetition to look where it matters most.

wakingup.title: A PERFECT meditation app

Unfortunately I had to step away from the app for awhile for financial reasons but then I heard about their scholarship program and they helped me out, which was INCREDIBLY gracious of them. I love this app.

I often listen to these on and off daily and I find them to be a great comfort and also a good platform to build my practice off of.  I also appreciate the daily practices Sam has made available that focus more on the non-dual perspective.  After about a year of developing a daily practice it’s been a natural progression to delve more deeply into the path using the resources of Waking Up.

wakingup.title: Want Mindfulness Minutes - Apple Watch
wakingup.content: I enjoy this app and I think Sam Harris and most of the guests make excellent meditations. I just wish I could track the meditations with “mindfulness minutes” via the Apple health app.

wakingup.title: Like exploring a vast forest in my mind
wakingup.content: To call the app transformative would be an understatement, but that’s not really what it is all the time. I’ve had it for over 6 months and typically use it at night a few times per week. When I first started I was overwhelmed by the abstract concept of “non-self” that Sam talks about. To be honest I’m still wrapping my mind around this. But the best analogy I can come up with is that when I’m actually able to meditate, sometimes for only a minute or two, it feels like being dropped in a vast, beautiful, forest or distant island. I am now aware of this massive landscape in my mind, though I don’t always remember the way to get there. When I arrive, though, it’s unforgettable and truly powerful. The feeling is reminiscent of a religious revelation from my time in a Baptist tradition. I could go on with the analogies because that’s the only way I know how to vaguely put in words how meditation feels. Like so many things with the mind, such as psychedelics, you quickly learn that words and language are inadequate tools to describe what you “see” and “feel” in meditation. Suffice to say, I highly recommend this app to anyone patient and curious enough to read this review. Thank you, Sam.

wakingup.title: So much more than a meditation app

What a mench!

wakingup.title: Life Changing!
wakingup.content: I am not exaggerating by any means when I say this application single handedly changed my life and my perspective for better. The importance of this simple yet profound practice cannot be overstated. Sam Harris’s approach to meditation makes it an easy habit to incorporate in your daily. Over the past years, this has helped me form better relationships, be more present and understanding. Most of all, it makes daily living a joyous experience. I cannot recommend it enough.

wakingup.title: Amazing
wakingup.content: Truly life changing. I want to offer a similar cost break in the future for my services because of this app

wakingup.title: Learn what meditation really is and truly understand yourself
wakingup.content:
This is the most comprehensive meditation guide I’ve used. Learn what meditation really is with complementary Theory and Life sections. All sections—Practice, Theory, and Life—are filled with expert guest content, allowing for a comprehensive perspective on meditation.

“Real meditation is the act of leaving everything as it is.”

“Meditation is the result of something you cease to do.”

– Sam Harris

I like the Daily Meditations, but when I want to dive deeper, the Practice section is full of over 30 meditations with leading teachers and multiple sessions. Some meditations have up to 48 sessions.

This app goes beyond a simple habit you do to relax; it guides you to experience the real freedom of mindfulness. An ongoing work-in-progress for me.

The Theory section helps you understand why you’re practicing “with the best of ancient wisdom pressure-tested by modern science.”

The Life section provides “wisdom for a more examined, fulfilling life.” It has lessons on embracing discomfort, procrastination, time management, doing good, sleep, resilience, and so much more.

I’m a Making Sense podcast listener and have greatly appreciated Sam Harris and his guests insights. I’ve tried other meditation apps but decided to give this one a try after listening to the podcast for so long, and I’m so glad I did. This app helped me gain new perspectives into meditation that the others simply lack. It’s no longer just a task to check off but a new of seeing and being.

Skip the “hacks” and truly understand yourself; you won’t regret it.

wakingup.title: Life Changing
wakingup.content: I would go on and on mentioning the wonderful qualities of this app and it’s content. But, to be brief and share as substantially as possible so that someone may take advantage , I have to say that it is humbling to see the kind of work and intention that is put into every detail of this tool. From the graphics to the interface, from the message to the way and the order in which the material is published, from the involvement of Sam Harris in the different sections of the app, to kind hearted guests and creators with contagious peaceful energy, there is so much power, so much love, and an immense amount of generosity coming from everything around this life changing tool.

wakingup.title: Simply Amazing
wakingup.content: I cannot say enough about this app. Whether you use it for the guided meditations, the lectures, or the discussions, there is not an invaluable resource to be found. Worth every penny.

wakingup.title: Irrational Cost
wakingup.content:
Update 7/14/24: I received a message from developer suggesting I request scholarship to get access to the app at a lower or no cost. Unfortunately my point below was not only about cost, but about cost in relation to provided value (or lack thereof). In summary, this is not worth the price they charge for a subscription product. It is ridiculously priced. I am keeping my 1 star rating.

————————

The cost is completely ridiculous per their yearly plan and beyond ridiculous on a month to month basis. Why would anyone want to pay a “subscription” on something that should not be worth more than the cost of an audio CD set. I found a very minimal part of the content ok which relates to meditation, but most of the content is not meditation at all and seems as an attempt to justify subscription cost with garbage, with guests rambling on some topics or podcast type interviews. The free version of “Insight Timer” is obviously much better.

wakingup.title: Amazing and Life Changing
wakingup.content: Without the scholarship I couldn’t afford this app. I am so unbelievably grateful for Sam’s generosity. This app, Sam Harris in general has been the remedy for life my husband and I have spent years looking for.

wakingup.title: A Life transforming application
wakingup.content: This app is priceless… it contains hundreds of resources you need for a peaceful life.

wakingup.title: Life Changing
wakingup.content:
I’ve used to try meditation sometimes and enjoyed it but could never stick to it. Then I recently had a traumatic event. I survived a near death experience, and I have not felt like my former emotionally resilient self. Anxiety was taking me down these emotional roller coasters and I couldn’t be productive, it was driving me crazy. 

I eventually found this app because I heard meditation can help with anxiety. I cannot tell you how instrumental this app has been for helping me catch myself before I go into these emotional tail spins. Its help me build this  awareness of my thoughts and how they start to go into these patterns. And that I can decide to just come back to the present moment when I choose.

It’s only been a few weeks of using it everyday. And I feel so much more empowered against my anxiety now. Can’t wait to see where I will be a year from now.

So thank you Sam Harris and the “Waking Up Team”!

wakingup.title: Thankful
wakingup.content: Thank you for this app

wakingup.title: Highly recommend
wakingup.content: Best meditation app I have ever used because of its sheer scope and richness. The interviews are phenomenal and place these meditative traditions in their deeper contexts, both cultural and philosophical. I am also always impressed by Sam’s efforts to veer the discussions in a direction that will serve his listener’s needs— the fine balance he strikes between the esoteric and the pragmatic. There is something here for everyone. Extremely grateful to be supported by this wonderful app in my meditative and contemplative practices.

wakingup.title: Waking up
wakingup.content: I’ve been meditating regularly since 2017 with occasional guidance from various books and recordings. Sam Harris has introduced some very interesting practices and concepts that have opened up my practice and added depth to my understanding of what meditation is and can be. I love the conversations, additional teachings and food for thought that accompany this app. Shout out to the Rich Roll podcast for introducing me to Sam!

wakingup.title: Highly, highly recommend
wakingup.content: I have attempted mediation on and off for years. Always feeling like I failed and never really being able to grasp it. Using this app is the first time I have ever felt I can do it. Something is clicking for me and I intend to keep exploring and practicing because of this app.  It is exciting. I am grateful.

wakingup.title: Clutch
wakingup.content: Best meditation app.

wakingup.title: Outstanding 28 day course
wakingup.content:
The course is absolutely a game changer. Worth every minute and money spent. Sam’s perspective and gentle curious approach to learning how to have a conversation with your mind is really a gateway to a more contented life. 
The app is a very generous way to further explore. Thank you!!!

wakingup.title: This App has change my life in the best way possible
wakingup.content: The Waking Up app has change my life in the best way possible, I used to have a short fuse and get upset very easily since I deal with chronic lower back pain but this app has changed how I view my pain and every interaction in my life so that others don’t pay the consequences just because I don’t “feel” good that day. It has thought me that even though its chronic pain it is just a sensation that im observing which in a way gives me some power over it even though its very uncomfortable to deal with. It has also thought me to take a moment and recognize my thoughts/feels before speaking so that im not lashing out on people just because im uncomfortable which i believe just makes my family’s/friends life more enjoyable and for that ill be forever grateful. I highly recommend this App

wakingup.title: Game changer for new and experienced meditators
wakingup.content: I actually heard of this through a friend, never having heard of Sam Harris. I’m currently using the scholarship, but when im in the position to pay for this app, I absolutely will. It’s worth every single penny. The app has more functionality and variety than most meditation apps. It is also more mature, thoughtful and in-depth in its content. If you want to expand your way of thinking, deepen your practice of meditation, or start fresh with new perspectives, this is the perfect app. I adore how much the design of this app is crafted with genuine care, thought, and respect for the user. Every little thing you can think of to personalize your experience is there. (Meanwhile, other apps like headspace don’t have playlist features, are constantly glitching, and are a bit juvenile/surface level in content). Please do yourself the favor and use waking up. I’ll be using it indefinitely myself.

wakingup.title: Life Changing
wakingup.content: This app has transformed my life. I cannot recommend this app enough to anyone even slightly interested in meditation. Also the customer service team goes above and beyond if you are needing an extended trial. Just wow, thank you so much Sam Harris and the entire Waking Up team.

wakingup.title: The best

And even my clients meditate.  Ive tried to motivate and stay on track with meditation for over 20 years and this was one of the primary tools that got me to sit every day again.  Thanks Sam Harris and the Waking Up Team!!!  May you all be well, may you be peaceful, and may your hearts be at ease.

wakingup.title: Best meditation app!
wakingup.content:
I’ve tried others, but I love this one best of all. 
Sam’s voice and pacing are perfect for me, and the clarity and simplicity of his instruction in these guided meditations are just what I needed.

I have shared a few sessions with my husband, and now we plan to start the course again and go through it together, so it’s added a beautiful new dimension to our relationship. 

I have also shared this with many friends, associates and family members with complete confidence that it could be of service to all of them. Plus, it’s beautiful and elegantly done.

Sam Harris’ generosity in sharing this wealth of teaching and tools for life is beautiful, and he may never know how many lives he has touched by doing so. Certainly mine has been changed for the better. Thanks, Sam! I am so grateful. 🌹❤️

wakingup.title: Grateful

It’s an incredible tool and support, I’m so grateful to the entire Waking Up team and the many people who have contributed to it over the years. What an invaluable resource for helping people find their way.

wakingup.title: This is what finally got me into meditation
wakingup.content: Thanks!

wakingup.title: Fantastic Experience: what my practice was missing
wakingup.content: Everything about this app is done right, in my opinion. Here are some of my favorite parts about it: -Absolutely no ads. -Clear progression of guided meditations which develop a cohesive learning and personal exploration path. -Offers a scholarship to cover subscription cost for a limited time. -Additional theory content provided to accompany each meditation session. -Exposure to a diverse set of thinkers in the realm of mindfulness, philosophy and spiritual exploration. I’ve used multiple other popular apps including Headspace and Calm for years and love those as well. The distinguishing factor for this app is the ability to dive deeper into the theory and historical/scientific development of mindfulness practice. Sam Harris does a great job of synthesizing lessons from multiple fields of study related to mindfulness such as philosophy, cognitive science, psychiatry, neuroscience, ethics, spiritualism, and Eastern religions.

wakingup.title: What happened to monthly subscription
wakingup.content: The lectures and discussions are great, best in depth discussion of Buddhism by far out of apps I’ve tried, monthly price was a little steep but I would get it when I could afford, cancel it when I couldn’t, but now I can’t find monthly payment plan only yearly and living paycheck to paycheck no way I can afford to pay for a year up front. Bummer.

wakingup.title: A Stand Out App
wakingup.content:
I will highlight the elements to this app that I think make it great both in features and content. 
- Content: Genuine Non-Judgemental attitude surrounding how much you meditate. Once you feel non-dualism as a valid experience of life, you see moments in life more consistently as a form of meditation. I believe while other apps try to emphasize this, they fail to follow through because they will send you reminders that are worded in a way that make you feel like you aren't doing well. This app, every "moment" it sends you through the day helps you remember the mental framing we all choose to do.
- Features: I think the moment feature (along with its brief session/idea) is very well done. The app has a variety of ways to customize your sessions, background noise, length, bells, etc that I think give it more flexibility and allow you to experiment. Which highlights.. 
- Content: Sam Harris, seems to have approached meditation with a heavy experimentation viewpoint. While I don't inherently agree with the need to fundamentalize (or break down to base components) of every aspect in life, that is here nor there. This app does a good job at exposing you to the variety of sensations/emotions your brain/body has. I believe many other meditation apps do not emphasize the experimentation with emotions. Whether that is a session of metta, or on the flip-side (one that makes you a little sad), then truly noticing where those sensations lie in your body, the emotion itself manifesting. It is a form of therapy truly, a real connection to self where you recognize you DO HAVE feelings and not just a false sense of self-perception and self-distance. 

I could go on for a while about the positives around the philosophy and features. I really think this app helped me "utilize" mindfulness and realize it in many more aspects in my life. 

But, I will also highlight a negative,
-Content: Sam Harris may be a great example of a kind and considerate and VERY intelligent white man in the US, surrounding meditation and neuroscience. But he said a few things around the 2020 protests that made me reconsider using this app. Those comments turned me off to looking at any of his content around "life" and "philosophy." I think there is a complicated element to the ideas that all of his white co-hosts tend to bring up and it supports some mental framework that I'm not sure I always agree with. I am by no means saying these sessions say anything that is either outright racist, or endorse colorblind racism, but I do not think it's a coincidence Sam Harris doesn't host a lot of minorities.

wakingup.title: Transformational- Highly Recommend!
wakingup.content: As a long-term meditation practitioner, I’ve used most of the popular meditation apps available. After using Sam’s Waking Up app for the past few months, I’ve come to appreciate it as my go to meditation support app. In my opinion, there’s no meditation app available that compares with the high-quality and transformational nature of Sam Harris‘s Waking Up app.

wakingup.title: Love
wakingup.content: Meditation is the most useful skill I have learned as an adult. It has made my life so much better and has helped me be better for others. Thank you Sam.

wakingup.title: Truly life changing
wakingup.content: I’ve tried developing a meditation routine many times in the past but nothing ever seemed to stick. With the help of this app, I finally have a meditation practice I can stick to and count on. The lectures and conversations are helpful and quite enjoyable as well. Couldn’t recommend more.

wakingup.title: Literally saving my life
wakingup.content:
I’m diagnosed with Bipolar II, and this app has been my source of wisdom and insight in the face of truly unbearable mental anguish for the past 3 years. When I’m paralyzed with depression, I listen to talks by Sam, Joseph, Adyashanti, and the other incredible teachers. That voice in the darkness isn’t much, but it’s enough to get me through the night. 

Daily practice with Sam has helped me learn to transform my relationship to suffering - even the extreme suffering of a bipolar episode. Such a shift is truly the difference between life and death. 

I need to state that Waking Up isn’t the only tool I have — it’s part of a broader arsenal. But I don’t know where I would be without it. 

Thank you, Sam and co., for giving me a resource that’s truly saving my life.

wakingup.title: Life-changing :)
wakingup.content: Waking Up has transformed my meditation practice. The app’s introductory course is incredibly valuable, offering clear and insightful guidance for beginners and experienced meditators alike. The wide range of resources available, from lessons to guided meditations, provides a comprehensive toolkit for personal growth and mindfulness. Sam Harris’s thoughtful approach and the app’s user-friendly interface make Waking Up an essential part of my daily routine. Highly recommended for anyone looking to deepen their meditation practice and improve their mental well-being.

wakingup.title: I don’t know how to appreciate this app
wakingup.content: I can’t say enough how I am surprised by waking up app. It is my first review after a decade I am not a comment person but couldn’t resist and not to appreciate the afford Sam is putting in to this app. Best app out there to have a best experience meditation app in your whole life I promise you! If you don’t have the motivation to start meditation, just play first 14 days and you can see your life divides into before and after the experience! Hope you enjoy this app and make it a habit to make your mind a beautiful place ❤️

wakingup.title: Best App so far

Sam provides a clear understanding about what meditation is and also clears up common myths that many people still believe including the goal of meditation being to have an “empty mind” or to feel a certain way by the end of it. Looking forward to exploring the rest of the App.

wakingup.title: • thank you •

Thank you for helping replace these things I thought I had lost. Thank you for the work you do. I will also continue to subscribe to and support Making Sense.

For example when playing a meditation then when you lock your phone to listen to the meditation without the screen on sometimes the audio stops when you lock your device. This bug gets resolved if one refreshes the app. Then when using the custom self timer after listening to one of the short Beyond Concepts, or The Nature of Now sessions the audio doesn’t play at all sometimes. This bug unfortunately can’t be resolved by refreshing the app using multitasking. 

This app otherwise is so profound I really enjoy Loch Kelly and Henry Shukman’s teachings. I’ve invested in reading books written by both of these lads.

Thanks for the app!
- Elliot

meditopia_us.title: Огромная разница в цене между Россией и США

However, one aspect that could use improvement is customer service. Despite being a Lifetime Premium member, I've experienced challenges in getting responses to any issues I’ve raised. meditopia_us.title: Best in class meditation app
meditopia_us.content:
I’ve used three or four of the other popular meditation apps, and found one or two to be very helpful. For example, Headspace was responsible for helping me establish a regular 10 minute per day practice that I have maintained faithfully every day for the past five years. 

I supplemented my meditation with other apps from time to time. And recently I discovered Meditopia. I like this app best of all. Mostly because of the combination of soothing music that has a special quality I’ve not found elsewhere, and the quality of the woman’s voice that guides the meditation. 

There’s something about the blend of music, voice, and the words she uses, that make this meditation the most enjoyable and most relaxing of all the apps I’ve tried. 

So there several really good ones, but this is the best in my opinion. Of course, my opinion is just one perspective. You’d have to try it and come to your own conclusions based on your unique preferences. 

But, if you’re looking for a good meditation app to try, this one is worth checking out for sure.
